records.name: Astrolabio
records.tagline: Your AIs pick up right where you left off, on your Mac
records.description: Every new AI chat starts from scratch. Astrolabio keeps a notebook for each project: status, decisions, rules, to-dos. Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI and Antigravity read it on their own and keep it updated. Stays on your Mac.

records.name: Juncts
records.tagline: Superhuman for your DMs, with AI that triages and drafts
records.description: Juncts centralizes LinkedIn, X, Instagram, WhatsApp and Telegram into one powerful, keyboard-first inbox, then lets AI do the heavy lifting. Connect Claude or ChatGPT to catch up on what you missed, triage and label conversations, and draft replies across every app. Labels, reminders, scheduled messages, split views and CRM sync built in. You set the AI's access level, and nothing sends unless you allow it. 14 days free, no card.

records.name: Claude Ship
records.tagline: Ship code as fast as you can write it
records.description: Ship code as fast as you can write it: Claude Ship reviews, fixes, and approves pull requests, taking each one from opened to ready to merge. Code Review posts verified findings on each PR. PR Steward (beta) fixes failing CI, conflicts, and review feedback, but never merges. Claude Approvals (beta) approves routine changes under your team's policy file and asks a human about the rest. Run /ship in Claude Code to push, open the PR, and hand it off. For Claude Team and Enterprise on GitHub.

records.name: tday.com
records.tagline: Ask your coding agent for a narrated demo of any feature
records.description: Most features ship without a demo video. A good one takes hours to script, record, retake, voice and edit. Ask for a demo in one line from Claude Code, Cursor or Codex. Your coding agent records your real app on your machine, localhost included, and tday adds the voice, cursor, zooms, captions and your brand. Edit any narration line, then use it in your launch, docs or changelog. Web, desktop, terminal, iPhone and Android apps. Your code never leaves your machine. Free for 5 saved demos.

records.name: Hourly Journal
records.tagline: Journal your hours, understand your days
records.description: Ever wondered where your entire day went? Hourly Journal helps you keep track of what you do, how you feel and how you spend your time. A quick check-in every hour helps you discover patterns, understand yourself better and be more intentional about your day. Available on iOS, Android and the web.

records.name: SparrowDesk Phone Calls
records.tagline: Phone support in the same inbox as email, chat & WhatsApp
records.description: Phone support inside your helpdesk. SparrowDesk Phone Calls puts calls in the same inbox as email, chat and WhatsApp. Buy a number in 51 countries, route callers with a visual IVR or an AI agent, and answer from the browser. Every call is recorded, transcribed and handled like any other ticket. No per-seat voice fees: pay as you go from a prepaid Voice Wallet.

records.name: Granular.Build
records.tagline: Put your AI agents to work in a visual workspace
records.description: Big ideas shouldn't require a dozen AI tools or a programming background. Granular brings your models, agents, files, and project context into one visual workspace. Give a boss agent your goal, let it coordinate specialists in parallel, and watch apps, designs, or videos take shape with live previews. Bring your own AI, use built-in terminals and plugins when you need them, and keep each project's memory and files in one place. Go from first plan to published result.

records.name: Prates
records.tagline: Learns how you write, then writes exactly as you would
records.description: Prates learns from what you write across any app: who you write to, your projects, your views and your wording. It turns speech into finished text, drafts replies and completes what you type. What it learns stays as short notes on your Mac that you can read or delete. Voice and text go only to the models you choose and have available, locally or in the cloud. macOS 14+. 7-day free trial, then $9.99 per month.

records.name: Umami Manager
records.tagline: Umami reports, widgets & links – native on iPhone & iPad
records.description: Umami Manager 3.0 brings your Umami analytics to iPhone and iPad – cloud or self-hosted. New in 3.0: in-depth reports like events, sessions, compare, breakdown, attribution, Web Vitals, errors and realtime, links and pixels in their own tabs, widgets for any website, link, pixel and metric, and multiple windows on iPad and iPhone Duo. Manage websites, teams and users across accounts. Native and privacy-first – try it free for 7 days.

records.name: Mystonie
records.tagline: Log movies, shows, books & games — turn finishes into art
records.description: Mystonie is a free, ad-free journal for everything you finish: movies, TV shows, books, manga, and games. Turn every finish into shareable artwork cards, explore your World Atlas, search movies by plot, play daily movie games, and add Android widgets.

records.name: Willow iOS 2.0
records.tagline: No switching apps while you dictate
records.description: Tap the mic and talk without leaving the app you’re writing in. Willow brings dictation and Scribe into your iPhone keyboard, alongside swipe typing, smarter autocorrect, emoji, and cursor control. Speak a longer thought, type a quick edit, and keep going.

records.name: Viktor Code
records.tagline: Coding agents know your repo. Viktor knows your company.
records.description: Coding agents know your repository. Viktor knows your company: your customers, your metrics and the decisions behind the work. So you give him a business outcome, not a ticket. He splits it into the technical and the non-technical work. He opens pull requests on your GitHub, GitLab or Bitbucket repos and brings them back for your review. His projects belong to the whole team, in Slack, Teams or Discord. Anyone can code now. Free to start, with up to $100 in credits.

records.name: Ohhai
records.tagline: Type messy, send clean: an AI keyboard for iPhone
records.description: Ohhai is an AI keyboard for iPhone. Type fast, mistakes and all, and Return puts in the clean phrase. Or talk, or translate into over 40 languages, in any app. Stuck on a reply? Press the Action Button for three drafts. You always press send.

records.name: Finseo
records.tagline: Company brain + outreach to get your brand mentioned by AI
records.description: Finseo now acts on your AI visibility, not just measures it. Company Brain puts your website, docs, Drive, Search Console, GA4 and AI tracking into one searchable map: ask anything, get answers with sources. Outreach finds the pages AI answers cite where your brand is missing, finds the editors and drafts pitches in your brand voice, with every claim checked against your Brain before you approve.

records.name: Wellbreak
records.tagline: Your wellbeing buddy in Mac's notch
records.description: Wellbreak is a wellbeing buddy for your Mac. He lives in your notch and takes each break with you: look away, blink, stand, stretch, drink water, sit up tall. He waits while you type, steps aside on calls, and his face shows how your day is going. Pay once, no account, and your history stays on your Mac.

records.name: Cullman
records.tagline: Faster voice agent evals, from simulation to production
records.description: Cullman is an evals platform for building and shipping reliable voice agents. Evaluate every prompt, model, and voice change with text simulations, voice simulations, and real human testers, scored against your custom rubrics. Compare versions, catch regressions, and validate improvements before you deploy. Run simulations in minutes and human tests in days. Then keep evaluating in production with live-call scoring, call traces, and split tests. Test, deploy, and improve your agent in one place.

records.name: Tendor
records.tagline: Write it or ask it, from anywhere on Windows
records.description: Write down a thought or ask AI without leaving what you're doing. Press a hotkey and Tendor opens over any app on Windows 11. Type to save a task or note, start with ? to ask AI, or ?! to send your screen too. The AI reads your tasks and notes from any day, asking before it opens an older one. Save instructions as Skills and run them with /name, or type /newskill and the AI writes one. Use your own key from 8 providers. Plain Markdown, no account, free to start.

records.name: Adanotch
records.tagline: A live Dynamic Island for your MacBook notch
records.description: Adanotch turns the MacBook notch into a live island: music, meetings, a file shelf with offline conversion, OCR and screen recording. It also shows AI agent approvals and usage limits for Claude, Codex and more. Native Swift, no account, 2-day free trial.

records.name: frwrd.to
records.tagline: Your link in bio, sorted by your AI in one message
records.description: Send your AI assistant your current link in bio or your website. It keeps what matters, matches your brand and publishes the page in every language you need. Campaigns end on their own, and you can edit everything by hand too.

records.name: Astor
records.tagline: AI Thesis Investing
records.description: Astor is the personal investing agent for thesis-driven investors. Tell Astor what you believe in, e.g. “the grid is AI’s bottleneck.” Astor builds the portfolio and explains every pick. It monitors your thesis every market day, and when the story changes, it tells you how to adjust. You approve every trade. Free to start.

records.name: K-Stra
records.tagline: Geomarketing for Australia, with an AI that does the maths
records.description: Where should we open next? K-Stra answers that for retailers, franchise networks and property teams in Australia. Give it an address and it draws the real drive-time catchment, then shows who lives there, what they earn and spend, which competitors are nearby, what property costs and an estimate of road and foot traffic. An AI assistant sets up the analysis from a plain-English question and shows the price in credits before anything runs. Free to explore, no subscription required.

records.name: Rotara
records.tagline: Mac workspaces, one flick away
records.description: Each project gets its own windows. Switch and only that project is on screen, every window exactly where you left it, and Dock clicks and links open right there. A pie menu opens at your cursor and one flick takes you there, or use ⌃1–9 or a swipe. ⌘Tab shows only this project's apps and the pie sits on keys you already press, so it feels like part of macOS. Nothing to set up. 14 days free, then $19 once.

records.name: Context
records.tagline: The calendar that gets you ready for every meeting
records.description: Context brings your Google, Outlook and iCloud calendars together, understands what you type, and before every meeting tells you who you are seeing, what you talked about and what was left open.

records.name: Finer Screenshot
records.tagline: Add text that automatically stays readable on any background
records.description: It's faster to show than to tell. Text you add gets an outline and shadow that adapt to what's under it, so it stays readable on any background. Finer Screenshot opens in about 200 ms, and its redaction mosaic is drawn from made-up text, so there's nothing underneath to recover. $19.99 once, 14-day free trial. Mac now, Windows is coming soon.

records.name: distribution.dev
records.tagline: Advertise to developers on many sites with one campaign
records.description: Anyone can build a product now, so the hard part is getting people to see it. distribution.dev is an ad network for developers, built by the publishers themselves: daily.dev and DEV (dev.to), together among the largest developer content platforms in the world. You set up one campaign and it runs on many developer sites at once, with ads made to fit in on each one.

records.name: Kodak SlideTag
records.tagline: A 1935 film-slide E-Ink frame that tracks like an AirTag
records.description: Inspired by vintage Kodachrome slide mounts, Kodak SlideTag is a tiny photo display with a six-color E Ink screen you can update from your phone. It doubles as a tracker for Apple Find My or Google Find Hub and comes in $34.99 blind boxes.

records.name: Even G2 Enterprise SDK
records.tagline: Build custom business apps for Even G2 smart glasses
records.description: Connect Even G2 smart glasses directly to your own mobile applications with Flutter, native iOS and Android SDKs

records.name: Clam AI
records.tagline: Your inbox, safely shared with AI agents
records.description: Your inbox is a master key: password resets, bank alerts and health reports all run through it. Clam lets AI agents work in your email without holding that key. You write the rules in plain English, like "Read travel email. Draft replies. Never send." Each agent sees and does only what its rules allow, and you see everything it tries. We start with Gmail. We are building the permission layer for MCP: one that understands what the data means and the context of every request.

records.name: Almma's PII Guard
records.tagline: Catch personal data before it reaches your AI chat
records.description: A free, open-source browser extension that flags names, emails, numbers, dates and addresses in the message box of claude.ai and chat.almma.ai, and replaces them with placeholders like [NAME_1] before you send. Pasted text is held for review. Typed text is underlined in red and Send is blocked until you decide. Everything runs locally: the code contains no network calls, and the README shows how to check. MIT licensed.

records.name: HeroUI Pro 1.0
records.tagline: Premium UI components, templates, and AI tooling for React
records.description: HeroUI Pro is the premium tier of HeroUI (formerly NextUI). 118+ production-ready Pro components with 900+ examples: 65+ for React, built on Tailwind CSS v4 and React Aria (data grid, charts, kanban, agenda, rich text editor, maps, and a full AI chat kit), and 53+ for React Native on iOS and Android. Plus full-page templates, and MCP servers and Agent Skills so Cursor and Claude build with your design system. One perpetual license, unlimited projects.

records.name: Fleetify
records.tagline: Open-source command center for your AI coding agents
records.description: Fleetify is a free, open-source desktop app for running AI coding agents side by side. Start sessions with Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode and seven more agents, or with OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, OpenRouter and local Ollama models. Watch them all from the Fleet hub: status, spend, tokens and live activity. Give each task its own git worktree, preview your dev server, open PRs, and install a plugin once for every agent that supports it. macOS, Windows, Linux.

records.name: Agenda Hero Magic Labs
records.tagline: Any schedule. Any layout. Any style.
records.description: We’re replacing the static PDF calendar with a new kind of artifact built for date and time. From the team offsite to the soccer season, make a beautifully designed plan. It’s powered by live data, so when the plan changes, the design and subscribed calendars stay up to date. Try it today in Agenda Hero Magic Labs.

records.name: Pinned
records.tagline: Ask the city where to go tonight with your friends
records.description: Ask Pinned where to go tonight, the way you'd text a friend who knows the city. Pinned AI reads every spot nearby and brings back the three that fit your whole crew, with a reason for each. Then drop a pin with the plan, and your friends say "I'm down" in one tap. Try a real Ask at pinned.social, no download needed. Free on iPhone and Android, made in New York for people who'd rather be out than online.

records.name: Drift
records.tagline: Wallpaper that reflects the world around you
records.description: Drift is a living wallpaper for Mac. It paints slow, moving gradients on your desktop that shift with the time of day and your local weather: warm light at sunset, rain, snow and storms when they arrive. Start with one of our nine beautiful palettes or generate your own. Turn on Real Sky to match the light and weather conditions outside your window. It runs as your real wallpaper on every display, and as your screen saver too. Free for 14 days. Launch price $12/year until December 18, then $15.

records.name: Valley
records.tagline: Outbound system to find people most likely to buy from you
records.description: Valley finds the people most likely to buy from you, from live buying signals, plain-English search or your own lists. It checks each one against your ICP, researches them, and writes a personal message across LinkedIn and email. You approve every message, replies land in one inbox, and it runs from Claude or ChatGPT via MCP. Teams see 15-45% reply rates vs about 2% for cold outreach. Bolt.new booked 25 enterprise demos in 45 days. Book a demo to see it on your own leads.

records.name: doola MCP
records.tagline: Start and run your US company from your AI assistant
records.description: The doola MCP lets founders start and run a US company from ChatGPT, Claude, and any tool that supports MCP. Form an LLC or C-Corp in any of the 50 states in one chat, from account setup to submission. Already a doola customer? Connect your account and ask your AI Co-Founder for your EIN letter, formation documents and deadlines. doola Bookkeeping customers can also pull financial reports, and connected Shopify or ad accounts add sales and ad spend trends. Add mcp.doola.com as a connector.

records.name: LayAuto 4
records.tagline: Find any window, tab, or session on your Mac
records.description: LayAuto 4 is a window manager for Apple silicon Macs. Search and jump to any window, browser tab, terminal session, or project; group them by context; restore layouts automatically; and use two Macs as one workspace. Most features are free.

records.name: InField
records.tagline: Translate and refine text where you type, on Mac and Chrome
records.description: Translating something usually means leaving it: open a translator or AI, paste, copy, come back, and paste again. InField skips the trip. Tap Shift twice in any text field on your Mac or in Chrome, and InField translates or polishes what you wrote. Tap Shift once more and replace it. Write in your language, the target one, or a mix of both, and get one clean text. Fix grammar, structure, and tone. Select text to translate it. InField detects the source language for you.

records.name: Bento terminal
records.tagline: A multi-pane terminal workspace for one project
records.description: Bento is a full-screen terminal workspace for one project: preview and edit files, review changes, run builds, open a shell, and run coding agents beside the preview. No more multi-tab terminal juggling — one Bento window holds the workspace, with shell tabs inside. Let your AI agent do the work while you watch changes in real time, see what is staged for git, and run tests while the dev server keeps running. In-app updates. Single Go binary, MIT, macOS, Linux, Windows.

records.name: Scribase MCP Server
records.tagline: A Postgres backend your coding agent sets up by MCP
records.description: Scribase MCP Server gives Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Windsurf, Zed and VS Code 97 tools over a hosted Postgres backend: database, auth, storage, realtime and functions. The agent creates the project, runs SQL and migrations, and writes the keys into your app. Reads run at once; destructive changes wait for your confirm, and schema changes can be gated on a passing row-level-security test. Remote server, nothing to run. Free for 14 days, no card, then from $5 a project.

records.name: mindyOne
records.tagline: Your Instagram DMs. Now with an AI receptionist.
records.description: mindyOne is an AI receptionist for your Instagram DMs. When someone asks for a time, it answers from your prices and hours, offers only slots that are really free, and books the appointment right in the chat: a name, a read-back and a yes. It also reschedules and cancels, says it's an AI, and steps back when you reply. Built for businesses whose DMs end in a booking: trainers, salons, photographers, studios, consultants. Build yours from a description and talk to it before you sign up.

records.name: DeskMagic
records.tagline: Shake your cursor, ask AI about anything on screen
records.description: DeskMagic is a Windows app that puts AI right next to whatever you're looking at. Shake your mouse, drag around a chart, error, email or foreign text, and the answer streams in beside it. Uses your own Claude, ChatGPT or Gemini key with no DeskMagic servers in between, no account, and history saved only on your PC. Highlight text to skip the screenshot entirely.

records.name: TouchDeck
records.tagline: Turn your iPhone or iPad into a control deck for your Mac
records.description: TouchDeck turns your iPhone, iPad or iPhone Duo into a control deck for your Mac: keys, rotary dials, sliders and a jog wheel. Pick any Mac app and it builds a deck from the shortcuts in that app's own menus, and your deck switches by itself when you change apps. One key can run a whole workflow. Pairs with a 4-digit code over local Wi-Fi, end-to-end encrypted, no account. The Mac app is free; 7-day free trial on iPhone and iPad.

records.name: Sotto
records.tagline: Hold a key, speak, clean text lands at your Linux cursor
records.description: Open-source desktop dictation for Linux (Wayland & X11). Hold a shortcut in any terminal, editor, or browser, speak naturally, and Sotto transcribes with your own Groq Whisper or ElevenLabs key in ~600 ms, cleans up filler words, and pastes at your cursor.

records.name: SEO Questions Bank
records.tagline: Free Arabic SEO answers, audits and an MCP server
records.description: SEO Questions Bank is a free Arabic reference for fixing SEO problems: 91 answered questions with tools, illustrated steps and WordPress fixes. It also has 33 free tools (full page audit, AI readiness checker, speed test, title checker), a daily SEO monitor with change alerts, a Chrome extension, and a free MCP server so Claude, Cursor or ChatGPT can audit a page, get the fix and re-check it. No sign-up, no paid plans.

records.name: BanglaCodes
records.tagline: Build websites and simple apps by describing them in Bengali
records.description: A Bengali-first AI platform for creating websites, simple apps, games, and tools. Describe what you want in Bengali, refine it with a live preview, and publish a shareable site. Start free; paid plans add tokens and hosting.

records.name: PlanTimetable
records.tagline: Conflict-free timetables in minutes, not days
records.description: Generate balanced, conflict-free timetables for schools, hospitals, hotels and restaurants. The open-source FET engine runs in the cloud as a background job - filter the result per group, teacher or room, then export to PDF or CSV.

records.name: Abondy
records.tagline: Turn one video into hundreds of posts by real people
records.description: Upload a video you already have. Abondy turns it into hundreds of new versions, each with its own crop, caption, sound and hook. Then thousands of real people post them on their own TikTok, YouTube, Instagram and Facebook accounts. 5 videos free.

records.name: Orbcast
records.tagline: Record product demos with your face in a bubble. Free.
records.description: A native Mac app for product demos: your screen plus a draggable camera bubble, mic and system audio, click highlights, pause and restart, trim and one-click MP4. Free and open source. No account, no watermark, no time limits. Videos stay on your Mac.

records.name: The Number Combo®
records.tagline: Interactive math and power labs
records.description: The Number Combo® is a calculator and lab toolkit with 12 labs (Math Lab™, Numeral Lab™, Fraction Lab®, Geometry Lab®, Imaginary Lab®, Matrix Lab®, Sigmoid Lab®, Phase Lab®, Voltage Lab®, DC Lab®, Power-System Lab®, and Power Diagram Lab®) and 15 Project Design Studio workspaces for preliminary UPS, feeder, transformer, short-circuit, arc-flash, grounding, power-quality, generator, cable, protection-device, load-capacity, and energy-cost studies.

records.name: Way of the Agent
records.tagline: A game that teaches you to build AI agents
records.description: Way of the Agent turns learning to build AI agents into a game. Walk a path of 218 short lessons in 2D or fly it as a 3D universe, build a small project in every module, and train in Defense, a mini-game where you catch prompt injections and data leaks. Stuck? Talk it through with a Socratic AI tutor. A daily task and fresh AI-agent news keep you going. Anthropic, OpenAI, Google and open models. 8 languages, on the web, iOS and Android. Free to start.

records.name: Engganyo
records.tagline: 🌟 Engganyo.com | Small Taps. Big Crowds.
records.description: A Social Media Exchange platform where you engage with other creators posts to earn credits. Use your credits to exchange for likes, follows, shares, and comments on your own posts.

records.name: Ciroc Vodka
records.tagline: CÎROC Vodka: Smooth, fresh taste crafted from French grapes.
records.description: CÎROC™ Ultra-Premium Vodka is distilled from fine French grapes for an exquisitely smooth, fresh vodka experience. The essence of CÎROC™ Ultra- Premium Vodka comes from fine French grapes, which are distilled a fifth time at the historic Distillerie de Maison Villevert - Chevanceaux in the South of France. CÎROC™ Ultra-Premium Vodka is gluten free.

records.name: UseCOS Canadian Calculators
records.tagline: Free Canadian Tax, CCB, Mortgage & Landlord Calculators
records.description: usecos 2.0 expands our free Canadian decision suite with 4 major updates: 1) 2026 Canada Child Benefit (CCB) & Carbon Rebate Estimator with CRA income thresholds. 2) Ontario Private Used Car Sale Tax (13% RST) Calculator comparing purchase price vs Red Book UVIP values. 3) Ontario Landlord N12 Notice & Move-Out Organizers. 4) 1-Click Embeds allowing creators to embed any tool ad-free. 100% private, runs client-side in your browser with zero signup or tracking.

records.name: DarkLM
records.tagline: The uncensored AI that answers instead of refusing
records.description: DarkLM is an AI chat that answers the question you asked, without refusals or lectures. Its uncensored model writes full code, finds security flaws and writes dark fiction. Higher plans add Claude, GPT, Gemini and Grok in one chat. 2 free answers.

records.name: 7ssion
records.tagline: Messagerie gratuite en ligne, groupes et appels
records.description: Une messagerie gratuite en ligne pour les messages privés, les groupes, les channels et les appels audio et vidéo. Une alternative à Discord et Telegram.

records.name: ProctoHire
records.tagline: Online proctoring for hiring tests: screen, camera and desk
records.description: Online proctoring for hiring tests, in the candidate's own browser: the screen, the laptop camera, and the desk through the candidate's phone. Flagged moments come with a screen clip or a desk photo where there is one. A flag never rejects anyone by itself.

records.name: TheApp
records.tagline: 20 offline Android tools in one app, no ads, no account
records.description: I built TheApp because my phone was full of single purpose apps, each one with ads, an account or a subscription. TheApp puts 20 everyday tools in one Android app that works offline: gallery and file explorer, PDF scan, sign and merge, encrypted password vault, app lock, video editor, video and PDF compression, audio extraction, image converter, notes, budgets and more. No ads, no account, no cloud: your files never leave the phone. One payment, no subscription.

records.name: Kerryvo
records.tagline: Invoicing and business management for small teams in Spain
records.description: Kerryvo is cloud business management software developed by ERTIA for freelancers and small businesses. It brings quotes, delivery notes, invoices, expenses and payments together. Businesses can extend their plan with modules for accounting, advanced inventory, point of sale, Spanish road transport documents (DeCA) or veterinary practice management, depending on their needs and module availability.

records.name: MachPDF
records.tagline: Free PDF tools. Private, fast, no sign-up.
records.description: MachPDF makes everyday PDF tasks simple and free. Merge, split, compress, convert, edit and organize PDF files directly in your browser. Create invoices, quotes and other business documents without installing software or creating an account. Files are processed locally in your browser, without uploading them to external servers. No subscriptions. No registration. Just the PDF tools you need. Available in English and German.

records.name: ConvierteYa
records.tagline: Convert PDFs, images and videos in seconds
records.description: ConvierteYa is an easy-to-use online toolkit for working with PDFs, images, audio and videos. Convert, resize, compress, merge and split files directly from your browser. Get started with 5 free operations per day, with optional Premium plans for unlimited use. No software installation required.

records.name: Evening Coast
records.tagline: Take your AI on vacation to a 3D seaside island
records.description: Choose Solo, pick a nickname, and walk down to the beach. No account needed. Bring a browser-capable AI and you can explore the same island independently. Meet on the terrace, play beach soccer, or wander into the shops together.

records.name: The Good Tracker
records.tagline: Voice-first symptom, food and medicine tracker
records.description: The Good Tracker is a voice-first symptom, food and medicine tracker. Say or type how the day went and get a daily log. See what tends to line up in your entries, as a pattern, not a cause. One Insights chart you can adjust, a short doctor summary, a weather heads-up for tomorrow from your logs. Installs to the home screen. Free during early access. There is nothing to buy and no card is needed. A free account is required. Not medical advice.

records.name: Grimório
records.tagline: Free MTG deck builder: play it vs bots or your friends
records.description: Grimório is a free Magic: The Gathering deck builder for Commander/EDH, Modern and every format. Card suggestions from EDHREC, real decks and Commander Spellbook combos, each with its reason. Then play your deck against Forge bots or your friends online, or let the bots run quick test games. Windows, Linux, Android.

records.name: LinkGenList
records.tagline: Live directory of free premium link generators & leechers
records.description: LinkGenList is an all-in-one, daily-updated directory of working free premium link generators and multi-host leechers. Easily filter generators by specific file hosts (Rapidgator, Nitroflare, 1fichier, Turbobit, Katfile, etc.), check live working status indicators, and view file size limits and daily quotas without registration.

records.name: Player Sorter
records.tagline: Rank your favorite football players, one matchup at a time.
records.description: Player Sorter is a free online tool to rank your favorite football players. Pick a club or squad, choose between two players at a time, and get your ultimate ranking in minutes.

records.name: ETHTokenLaunch
records.tagline: Create ERC-20 tokens on Robinhood Chain, Base and more
records.description: ETHTokenLaunch creates ERC-20 tokens without code on Ethereum, Base, Robinhood Chain, BNB Chain and Elysium, the Hyperliquid Layer 2. Enter a name, symbol and supply, pay one fee from your own wallet, and a fixed-supply token is deployed with the whole supply sent to your wallet. No mint, blacklist or tax functions. It also has a free token lookup for checking any ERC-20 contract, and guides to Robinhood Chain, pons and adding liquidity.

records.name: DermInk
records.tagline: Create custom tattoo concepts from text or photos
records.description: Turn a sentence or reference photo into a custom tattoo concept. Sign up for 30 free credits. No card required.

records.name: Terminal Central
records.tagline: How to sign in to the OmniFlex virtual terminal
records.description: Independent publisher of practical merchant payments and virtual terminal guides.

records.name: Pradoy
records.tagline: Fake Chat, Post & Profile Screenshot Generators
records.description: Pradoy helps designers, creators, educators, and developers create realistic fictional chat screenshots, social media mockups, profiles, posts, and digital screen visuals in seconds. Build presentation assets, UI examples, prototypes, and creative visuals directly in your browser. No signup required — just create, customize, and export mockups for your next project.

records.name: Skill Tree Training

records.description: Skill Tree Training turns calisthenics into a skill tree of 400 skills, from your first incline push-up to the muscle-up, planche and pistol squat. Follow a program, log reps, holds and added weight, and each skill unlocks the next when you hit its target. records.name: FSiMX Studio
records.tagline: RTL simulation, waveform debugging & coverage in one IDE
records.description: FSiMX Studio is an integrated Electronic Design Automation (EDA) environment developed by WIOWIZ Technologies. It brings RTL simulation, SystemVerilog and UVM verification, waveform debugging, and coverage analysis into one workspace. Built around WIOWIZ's native simulation engine, FSiMX Studio helps semiconductor engineers compile, simulate, debug, and analyze digital designs.

records.name: CapitalStackOS
records.tagline: Credit stacking system agencies charge 10% of funding for
records.description: Credit card stacking works when the applications go in the right order, and it's what the big stacking agencies charge $5,000 to $10,000 flat, or 8 to 12 percent of everything you're approved for, to hand over. CapitalStackOS puts that sequencing into software: a free estimate from your own credit reports, a free cure plan if your file needs cleanup, then applications served one step at a time, with inquiry load and 0% promo clocks tracked. Self-Guided $99/month; Guided $4,000 for 12 months.

records.name: lsearch
records.tagline: Search local files like the web — offline, CJK-accurate
records.description: lsearch is a free desktop app that full-text indexes documents, code, PDFs and ebooks on your computer, pointing to the exact file, line and sentence. 27 formats, CJK-accurate search, Google-style queries and RE2 regex. Fully offline on Windows, macOS and Linux.

records.name: Research & Learning Skills for AI Agents
records.tagline: Research, verify and learn faster
records.description: AI agent skills for research planning, desk research, source evaluation, fact-checking, literature reviews, interviews, survey design, research synthesis and structured learning. - afeezadebayo/res...

records.name: LumaTidy
records.tagline: Clean up your camera roll, one surprise at a time
records.description: LumaTidy brings six animated themes and a media toolbox to your iPhone or iPad photo library. Rediscover old shots in a capsule machine or classic suitcase. Compare similar photos, compress photos and videos, and turn clips into GIFs or Live Photos. Use on-device privacy checks and blur a moving subject with automatic tracking. Revisit favorites in photo walls that play videos and Live Photos, or in Home Screen widgets. Free to start, ad-free, with optional lifetime Pro.

records.name: TattooStencil Hub
records.tagline: Redefining the Art of Tattoo Creation.
records.description: TattooStencilHub is an AI-powered tattoo creation and studio platform. Generate custom tattoo designs from prompts, convert photos and sketches into print-ready stencils with Thin, Medium and Bold line weights, and preview tattoos on your skin for free. Share designs, get community feedback with Rate My Tattoo, and explore creative tools built for tattoo lovers, professional artists and studios. From your first idea to the final stencil, create, visualize and prepare your next tattoo with AI!

records.name: Syria Up Close
records.tagline: Independent travel guide to Syria, in Arabic and English
records.description: An independent travel guide to Syria as it is today, with dated information from correspondents on the ground, in partnership with Ahleen for stays. It covers cities, countryside escapes, food and sweets, day trips, practical information for first-time visitors, and local guides, in Arabic and English. Free and non-commercial.

records.name: Images Converters
records.tagline: Free online image resizer & converter
records.description: Free online image resizer and converter — resize, compress and convert JPG, PNG and WebP. No signup, no install. Upload an image, choose a size or format, and download the result in seconds — free, fast and private, with no account or software needed.

records.name: JobAI
records.tagline: AI that finds your job, matches your resume, preps you
records.description: Job hunting eats hours: endless listings, a resume that never quite fits, cover letters from scratch. JobAI does the busywork in one place — search real job listings, see how your resume matches each one, generate a tailored cover letter, and walk in prepared with an interview coach. Start free; upgrade only if it helps. Built by a solo founder in Puerto Rico as part of Shambhala, a small city of honest AI tools.

records.name: CSV Change Watcher
records.tagline: Diff two CSV exports and see exactly what changed
records.description: One-file Python CLI that diffs yesterday's and today's CSV export: rows added, removed, and fields that changed (before/after/delta) in one Excel report plus a running log. Exits 2 when something moved, so cron only alerts when it matters. Free, MIT.

records.name: FLEY AI-VOCE
records.tagline: голосовой AI-ассистент для ПК, телефона и умных очков
records.description: Windows, Android, Linux и умные очки FLEY Glasses 1.0. Свой бесплатный API-ключ за минуту.

records.name: ROUND.1
records.tagline: Your first round, already done.

records.name: PlayBasket
records.tagline: Free basketball puzzles, quizzes and career games
records.description: Free basketball games for NBA, WNBA and EuroLeague fans: player guessing, grids, Bingo, trivia, rankings, draft and fictional career games. Choose daily challenges or repeat play in your browser. No account or download required.

The core runs without an AI model or hosted service.

records.name: DSOLVER CRM

records.description: DSOLVER CRM unifies sales pipeline, warehouse, invoicing, service tickets, and a B2B partner portal in one system. Stock updates automatically on deals, invoices reconcile with bank payments. From €149/month, 2-month free trial. Built for Lithuania and the EU.

records.name: Moshi-Where
records.tagline: Group trips to Japan, from the daily plan to the dinner bill
records.description: Plan your Japan trip together, save booking PDFs and photos, and split expenses. Free on Android, with an optional one-time group pass in supported markets.

records.name: Echo Connect

Free base plan with no forced sign-up.

records.name: VedicTemple

Upload an RFP and it pulls out the requirements and evaluation criteria, then asks you three things in chat: what the client really wants, what your real edge is, and the one point each slide makes. Then AI writes the slides, with speaker notes and source citations on every page. Export to PowerPoint. Try a real tender analysis with no sign-up, then start free with no card.

records.tagline: Free PDF tools that never upload your files
records.description: Most PDF converters ask you to upload sensitive documents to their servers. iConvertPDF does the opposite: all 25 tools run 100% client-side with WebAssembly and PDF.js, so files never leave your device. No account, no storage, no watermarks, no queues.

records.name: Eatreka
records.tagline: Tick off the world’s 195 cuisines, one meal at a time.
records.description: Eatreka is a free web app for ticking off the cuisines of all 195 countries. One rule: Vietnamese food in Liverpool ticks off Vietnam, not the UK, so most of the world is closer than you think. Log each meal with a photo, rating and note. Watch your board and continent progress fill up, keep a wishlist for next time, and share a card for every new country. Built solo. I’m on 7 / 195. What’s your number?

records.name: nRouter

records.description: Enterprise LLM gateway with active AI guardrails, deterministic smart routing, and token budget enforcement, included on every multi-tenant cloud account.

records.name: Gift Gift

records.description: Run your family's Secret Santa and gift lists from your phone, with no ads and no junk. Draw assignments in seconds, before anyone signs up. Manage lists for kids or relatives who aren't online. Import your Amazon list instead of starting over.

records.tagline: Free DJ press kit that applies to open calls for you
records.description: GATEBREAKER gives every DJ a free EPK on one link, then uses it to apply to live DJ open calls in one click. More than 400 open decks, competitions, residencies and festival slots, collected daily. Free plan forever, Pro from EUR 19.90 a month.

Howly keeps track of the time, reminds you when something needs attention, and helps you organize what to buy next with a built-in shopping list.

Anything contractual, financial or irreversible is handed back to a person for approval, and every agent action is logged. Deploy in your cloud or on-premises.

Describe a coding task and get a /goal or /loop command for Claude Code or Codex with success checks, a turn cap and stop rules. It also writes image prompts from a photo, video prompts with camera and pacing or a plain text prompt. Free to try without an account. Pro is $9 a month.

records.name: Aide
records.tagline: Set CPU and memory limits, pause what crosses them
records.description: Aide is a menu bar Activity Monitor for macOS. The dot inside the ring is gray while your Mac stays within your CPU and memory limits, and turns orange, then red, when it doesn't. Click the icon for a list of apps over a limit; you can pause, quit, or restart them. You set each limit with a slider. A spike counts if it holds for about 10 seconds. No notifications – the only signal of high usage is the orange or red dot. Direct download, 24 hours free, then a one-time $4.99 license.

records.name: Watermark Remover (Offline)
records.tagline: Remove photo watermarks offline — free, on-device, no ads
records.description: Remove repeated or single-photo watermarks, offline, on your device. Free, no ads, no account — your photos are never uploaded for processing.

records.tagline: Learn Anything, Fast!

Your conversations are never uploaded to external servers. Simple, fast, and privacy-focused. Keep your AI conversations whenever you need them.

Translate free on-device, paste a ready-made prompt into Claude, ChatGPT or Gemini, or run it automatically with your own API key. It backs up your live listing before every upload. For iPhone, iPad and Mac.

records.name: Gmoo Links

No sign-up, no watermark, works offline after the first visit, in 20 languages.

Decide.

records.name: EA Apps
records.tagline: 10 Shopify apps for more sales, each with a free plan
records.description: EA Apps is a suite of 10 Shopify apps made by one team and built to work together: email and SMS popups with spin the wheel games, a slide cart drawer with upsells, bundles and quantity breaks, free shipping and reward bars, announcement and countdown bars, SEO and page speed, an accessibility widget and store translation. Every app has a free plan, installs as an app embed without theme code edits, and can be set up by chatting with AI.

records.name: Floatage
records.tagline: Catch ideas. Stay offline. Pay once. No subscription.
records.description: Floatage isn't another notes app — it's where fleeting thoughts go before they disappear. Open it, tap +, write, done. No folders to pick, no setup, nothing between you and the idea. Pay once. No subscription, no ads, no account, no tracking. Everything stays 100% on your device: zero network requests, fully offline, on-device voice capture — audio is never saved or uploaded. Just 1.6 MB, in 15 languages, with Dark Mode.

records.name: FluentIn English
records.tagline: Master English, Spanish, or Portuguese in 5 daily minutes.
records.description: Learn English quickly and have fun with daily 5-minute micro-lessons, perfect for your routine. Pick up some basic Spanish and Portuguese along the way if you're an English speaker. Aprenda inglês de forma rápida e divertida com micro-lições diárias de apenas 5 minutos, perfeitas para sua rotina. Aprenda inglés de forma rápida y divertida con microlecciones diarias de tan solo 5 minutos, perfectas para su rutina.

records.name: Forgetta
records.tagline: Sends your birthday greetings in Telegram and Facebook
records.description: Forgetta doesn't remind you about birthdays: it sends the greeting itself, from your own Telegram or Facebook Messenger account. Each morning it checks whose birthday it is (Telegram, Facebook and, if you like, Google contacts) and sends one of the texts you picked. Greetings carry no name or age, so one text fits everyone; switch on several and it rotates them. 16 languages. Everything stays on the phone: no server, no ads, no AI. Android.

records.name: JavaScript Obfuscator by RichScripts
records.tagline: Protect your JavaScript from copying and tampering
records.description: JavaScript Obfuscator turns readable JavaScript into protected code that is far harder to understand, copy, or tamper with. Test it free online, protect larger projects with the desktop app or local CLI, and use published evidence paths when security, PCI, or procurement teams ask how the workflow is handled. Free online tool; paid plans from $29/month, with an optional JSO AI add-on. Online + desktop JavaScript protection since 2004.

records.name: Color Palette Hub: Color Tools
records.tagline: Paletas is an Android app for designers and digital creators
records.description: Create a palette for a website, illustration or brand and keep your color work organized with Color Palette Hub. Build combinations, compare shades and move from a color idea to an edited image in one workspace. Create and test color combinations for graphics, layouts and artwork. Features and format availability may vary by device or app version.

records.name: Dreamdrift: Baby Sleep Sounds
records.tagline: Nine gentle sleep sounds for babies, made by a mom
records.description: Dreamdrift brings nine gentle sleep sounds, a calm timer, and a simple sleep log together in one app, made by a mom for tired parents. White noise, gentle rain, ocean waves, a cozy fan, a car ride, and more, all in one calm place for bedtime and naps. Made slowly, with love, between naps and lullabies. Dreamdrift is in App Store review now. Join the waitlist and be first to know on launch day.

records.name: tday.com
records.tagline: Ask your coding agent for a narrated demo of any feature
records.description: Most features ship without a demo video. A good one takes hours to script, record, retake, voice and edit. Ask for a demo in one line from Claude Code, Cursor or Codex. Your coding agent records your real app on your machine, localhost included, and tday adds the voice, cursor, zooms, captions and your brand. Edit any narration line, then use it in your launch, docs or changelog. Web, desktop, terminal, iPhone and Android apps. Your code never leaves your machine. Free for 5 saved demos.

records.name: Hourly Journal
records.tagline: Journal your hours, understand your days
records.description: Ever wondered where your entire day went? Hourly Journal helps you keep track of what you do, how you feel and how you spend your time. A quick check-in every hour helps you discover patterns, understand yourself better and be more intentional about your day. Available on iOS, Android and the web.

records.name: Juncts
records.tagline: Superhuman for your DMs, with AI that triages and drafts
records.description: Juncts centralizes LinkedIn, X, Instagram, WhatsApp and Telegram into one powerful, keyboard-first inbox, then lets AI do the heavy lifting. Connect Claude or ChatGPT to catch up on what you missed, triage and label conversations, and draft replies across every app. Labels, reminders, scheduled messages, split views and CRM sync built in. You set the AI's access level, and nothing sends unless you allow it. 14 days free, no card.

records.name: Flashloop
records.tagline: Make AI videos and images from Claude, ChatGPT or your phone
records.description: Flashloop puts the newest video and image models in one place: Veo 3.1, Kling, Seedance, Nano Banana Pro, GPT Image and more, on web, iOS and Android. Pick a studio for the job. Ads Studio turns a product photo into ads and UGC videos, Film Studio shoots cinematic clips up to 1080p, Mirage swaps the people or products in a video while the camera moves stay, and Storycraft draws picture books and comics. Or run it all from Claude, ChatGPT or Cursor with our MCP server.

records.name: Viktor Code
records.tagline: Coding agents know your repo. Viktor knows your company.
records.description: Coding agents know your repository. Viktor knows your company: your customers, your metrics and the decisions behind the work. So you give him a business outcome, not a ticket. He splits it into the technical and the non-technical work. He opens pull requests on your GitHub, GitLab or Bitbucket repos and brings them back for your review. His projects belong to the whole team, in Slack, Teams or Discord. Anyone can code now. Free to start, with up to $100 in credits.

records.name: SparrowDesk Phone Calls
records.tagline: Phone support in the same inbox as email, chat & WhatsApp
records.description: Phone support inside your helpdesk. SparrowDesk Phone Calls puts calls in the same inbox as email, chat and WhatsApp. Buy a number in 51 countries, route callers with a visual IVR or an AI agent, and answer from the browser. Every call is recorded, transcribed and handled like any other ticket. No per-seat voice fees: pay as you go from a prepaid Voice Wallet.

records.name: Prates
records.tagline: Learns how you write, then writes exactly as you would
records.description: Prates learns from what you write across any app: who you write to, your projects, your views and your wording. It turns speech into finished text, drafts replies and completes what you type. What it learns stays as short notes on your Mac that you can read or delete. Voice and text go only to the models you choose and have available, locally or in the cloud. macOS 14+. 7-day free trial, then $9.99 per month.

records.name: Mole
records.tagline: Research that arrives as a document you can defend
records.description: AI assistants answer your questions confidently, but often incorrectly. They stop at the first plausible answer and don't go deep enough. Mole does. It traces all claims to their sources, uncovers the contradictions between those sources, and gets to the bottom of the facts. The result is a research report that is ready for you to rely on in professional, business, or academic settings where the facts and the numbers matter. Pay per report, from $10. The engine is open source.

records.name: Rainéo
records.tagline: Free packaging CAD: dielines, sheet layout & 3D folding
records.description: Rainéo is free packaging CAD software for cardboard and corrugated boxes. Draw 2D dielines from 41 FEFCO and 49 ECMA parametric styles, lay out ups on the sheet, plan pallets and truck loads, and fold your dieline in 3D with the board thickness. Export DXF, PDF, EPS, SVG and CF2 at 1:1. Windows app or online version (Mac and Linux in Chrome or Edge), in English and French. No subscription, no sign-up.

records.name: ClipOnIt
records.tagline: Turn ideas and long videos into animated videos and clips
records.description: ClipOnIt helps creators turn an idea or an existing video into content they can edit and share. AI Explainer builds animated videos with a script, visuals, voice and captions in 22 visual styles. Smart Clipper finds highlights in long videos, reframes speakers and adds word-by-word captions. Create, edit and export in one web app, with an API and MCP server for your workflows.

records.name: Ohhai
records.tagline: Type messy, send clean: an AI keyboard for iPhone
records.description: Ohhai is an AI keyboard for iPhone. Type fast, mistakes and all, and Return puts in the clean phrase. Or talk, or translate into over 40 languages, in any app. Stuck on a reply? Press the Action Button for three drafts. You always press send.

records.name: K-Stra
records.tagline: Geomarketing for Australia, with an AI that does the maths
records.description: Where should we open next? K-Stra answers that for retailers, franchise networks and property teams in Australia. Give it an address and it draws the real drive-time catchment, then shows who lives there, what they earn and spend, which competitors are nearby, what property costs and an estimate of road and foot traffic. An AI assistant sets up the analysis from a plain-English question and shows the price in credits before anything runs. Free to explore, no subscription required.

records.name: FixComply
records.tagline: Audit client sites: cookies, GDPR, accessibility, security
records.description: FixComply opens your client's site in a real browser, clicks Reject on the cookie banner and shows what keeps tracking. Plus privacy, accessibility and security checks on up to 20 pages, a fix for every issue, white-label PDF reports and weekly monitoring.

records.name: Audora
records.tagline: Free AI Music Generator, No Sign Up
records.description: Audora is a free AI music generator with no sign up required. Turn your lyrics, a song idea, a birthday wish, or a shared memory into a complete song with melody and vocals. Choose a genre, mood, instruments, and vocal style, or create instrumentals. No recording or music experience needed. Generation usually takes 2–3 minutes once it starts.

records.name: ZENTRA Fi
records.tagline: ZENTRA is a next-generation decentralized finance (DeFi)
records.description: ZENTRA Finance is a next-generation decentralized finance (DeFi) protocol designed to transform how digital assets are borrowed, lent, traded and deployed for capital efficiency. Built around the privacy-preserving and interoperable infrastructure of Canton Network, ZENTRA aims to create a unified financial ecosystem where users can access lending markets, borrow against supported digital assets, contribute liquidity and participate in yield-generation.

records.name: Alert51
records.tagline: Cron Job & Scheduled Job Monitoring
records.description: Alert51 is a monitoring and alerting tool for websites, APIs, and background jobs. It checks whether your endpoints are reachable and alerts you when a scheduled job misses its check-in. That covers both visible outages and silent failures, like a nightly backup that never ran. Group monitors by project, track incidents in one dashboard, and get alerts through Telegram. Daily or weekly reports show which jobs ran successfully and which need attention.

records.name: AIVA for Shopify
records.tagline: Your AI salesperson, live on your Shopify store 24/7
records.description: AIVA knows your whole Shopify catalog, shows shoppers their options, compares two, and closes. Your customer just talks, like a phone call; AIVA is the one on screen. Every conversation lands in your admin as a lead with a recording, AI summary and transcript.

records.name: Intonella
records.tagline: Catch every word at native speed, then say it like a native
records.description: For people who can read a language but lose it at native speed. Intonella works on one short dialogue at a time: listen without the text until you catch every word, read along, then speak along with the speakers (shadowing). The check draws the melody of your voice over theirs, line by line, beside your first cold read. English (US and UK), Spanish, French, German and Italian. Every pack has a free sample; buy a pack once, no subscription, no account.

records.name: KhelNayak
records.tagline: QR games for cafés and restaurants
records.description: Give guests something fun to do while they wait for their order. They scan a QR code at the table and play a quick browser game on their phones. Try a round of Tic-Tac-Toe in the sample café. KhelNayak works on its own; no ChefDesk or LoyaltyXchain account is required.

records.name: OctoMX
records.tagline: Innovative P2P app combining many networks in one
records.description: The most innovative P2P app: 90s WinMX style, brought into the future. One classic interface, one search across BitTorrent, eD2k/Kad, Gnutella, HTTP and more, and a single download can pull blocks from several networks at once. Open source, GPL3. Windows/Linux/macOS. Let's change the P2P world together. Why WinMX style? Just because the world is overcomplicating everything and I wanted to go back to the base, where everything started. Independent project, not affiliated with the original WinMX.

records.name: weedit Hide Sold‑Out Variants
records.tagline: Hide sold-out sizes, colors and more from the variant picker
records.description: When a value is sold out in every variant, such as XL, the app removes it from the variant picker on product pages. An optional mode also hides values that are sold out with the current selection. The selected value always stays visible. Hide values or grey them out, skip products by tag, and choose whether variants set to continue selling count as available. Switch it on as an app embed; a status panel in the theme editor shows what is hidden.

records.name: PenStranding
records.tagline: Every edition of your book, store-ready
records.description: The publishing studio for indie authors, in your browser. One manuscript in, every store-ready edition out: ebooks checked with EPUBCheck, paperback and hardcover interiors, covers from your own art and paste-ready kits for 10 stores. You press publish.

records.name: Chimp Test
records.tagline: A memory game where a real chimpanzee holds the high score
records.description: In 2007, a young chimpanzee named Ayumu beat Kyoto University students at a number memory test. Chimp Test lets you try it: classic mode, an Ayumu mode with the original 210 ms flashes, a daily challenge and five ranks. Free, offline, no account, 7 languages.

records.name: fiscal50
records.tagline: AI Bookkeeping Software for Small Business
records.description: fiscal50 is AI-powered bookkeeping and accounting software for small businesses and bookkeepers. It syncs bank and credit card feeds, recommends and explains every categorization, posts double-entry journal entries, reconciles accounts and produces financial statements, with invoicing, bills, inventory, fixed assets, 1099s and month-end close in one place.

records.name: From My Head to the App Store
records.tagline: How a veteran built a real app with AI in 66 days for <$1K
records.description: A field manual for anyone with an app idea and no team, no funding and no coding background to fall back on. Former U.S. Army Staff Sergeant William Fraizer Elliott carried an idea for six years, then built Sportsmen Ledger, a hunting and fishing license wallet for all 50 states, solo in 66 days for under $1,000 with AI. Every chapter ends with a Field Kit: the exact steps, the prompts he used, and the mistake to avoid.

records.name: Pixuvia
records.tagline: Pro layered editor and one-tap AI studio in your browser
records.description: Pixuvia gives you two ways to edit. The Editor is a full layered workspace: masks, selections, adjustments, filters, text, and PSD files you can open and save. The Studio keeps it to one tap per job: remove a background, erase an object, expand the frame, upscale, sharpen, relight, or describe the change in plain words. AI results land as layers you can mask or undo, and you can create new images from a prompt. Desktop, tablet and phone. Multilingual, nothing to install.

records.name: Booksolut
records.tagline: Booking software for shops: deposits and official WhatsApp
records.description: Appointment software for salons, clinics, gyms and shops: 24/7 booking page, deposits (Mercado Pago in Argentina), reminders to cut no-shows, official WhatsApp Cloud API bot (Business plan). Free plan, no card. Spanish, English, Portuguese.

records.name: DadderUp
records.tagline: The operating system for dads who want to show up!
records.description: DadderUp is a fatherhood operating system built by dads who needed it, too. The weekly Dadgenda gives you two daily challenges: one for you, one with your kid. Log a note, photo, video, or voice clip. Build streaks, earn badges and Dadder Bucks, and join Packs and private Squads in the TEDAM community (Together Every Dadder Achieves More). Get courses, videos, live webinars, and interviews with doctors and family specialists. Start with the free Mini ANCHOR Quiz.

records.name: Jiggicons
records.tagline: Animated SVG icons that move and sound like real things
records.description: 6,010 icons in outline, solid, duotone and glass (24,040 SVGs), each with its own spring motion and spatial sound. A bell swings, a heart thumps, a gift lid pops. For React, Vue, Flutter, SwiftUI and Compose, with a CLI and MCP server for coding agents.

records.name: Rotara
records.tagline: Mac workspaces, one flick away
records.description: Each project gets its own windows. Switch and only that project is on screen, every window exactly where you left it, and Dock clicks and links open right there. A pie menu opens at your cursor and one flick takes you there, or use ⌃1–9 or a swipe. ⌘Tab shows only this project's apps and the pie sits on keys you already press, so it feels like part of macOS. Nothing to set up. 14 days free, then $19 once.

records.name: Room Battle
records.tagline: AR tank battles in your room, built for iPhone Pro LiDAR
records.description: Your room becomes the battlefield: drop a toy-sized tank or helicopter on the floor and fight around real furniture. On iPhone Pro, LiDAR maps the room in 3D, so tanks hide behind a chair leg and shells ricochet off real walls. Free solo; duel on two iPhones.

records.name: Context
records.tagline: The calendar that gets you ready for every meeting
records.description: Context brings your Google, Outlook and iCloud calendars together, understands what you type, and before every meeting tells you who you are seeing, what you talked about and what was left open.

records.name: Finer Screenshot
records.tagline: Add text that automatically stays readable on any background
records.description: It's faster to show than to tell. Text you add gets an outline and shadow that adapt to what's under it, so it stays readable on any background. Finer Screenshot opens in about 200 ms, and its redaction mosaic is drawn from made-up text, so there's nothing underneath to recover. $19.99 once, 14-day free trial. Mac now, Windows is coming soon.

records.name: Multron Download Manager
records.tagline: Open-source download manager with yt-dlp & BitTorrent
records.description: Multron Download Manager is a fast, open-source desktop downloader built with Rust, Tauri v2, and Svelte 5. It combines a 64-connection HTTP/HTTPS accelerator, 4K video/audio extraction from 1,800+ sites via yt-dlp & FFmpeg, and a full BitTorrent client in one lightweight app. Featuring browser extensions, SHA-256 verification, and zero ads or telemetry, it runs natively on Windows, macOS, and Linux via winget, choco, scoop, brew, flatpak, and snap.

records.name: Reflections: Better Decisions
records.tagline: Make better decisions by learning from your own outcomes
records.description: Experience only builds if you remember what you decided and why. Details fade, and the answer comes months later. Reflections keeps each decision and checks back: the next day, then monthly until you score it. Speak it, and stress and energy are read from your tone. Reports reveal your decision patterns. Every figure comes from our own engine. Gemini 4 Hydrogen only writes the commentary; checks drop what your data doesn't support. Your decisions are your biggest investment. See the returns.

records.name: SkyLand
records.tagline: A Dynamic Island for Windows 11, with Claude Code status
records.description: SkyLand is a small floating pill on your Windows 11 screen. See when Claude Code is working or needs your OK, control music, run a focus timer, watch PC load and battery, and get Bluetooth, USB, charging and mic/camera pop-ups. It shrinks to a round icon when you don't need it. Free and open source, installs per user with no admin rights.

records.name: Brimlight
records.tagline: Animated Menu Bar Themes & a 3D Pet for Mac
records.description: Your menu bar is the strip of screen you look at all day, and it's always flat gray. Brimlight brings it to life. A 3D cat moves in: it hunts your cursor, chases yarn and naps when you step away. Play music and the bar becomes an equalizer while the cat dances. Pick from 41 living themes, from pixel-art sunsets to a sky that follows the real sun, and hang neon, garlands or sakura along the edge, even around the notch. Menus stay readable and clickable. Free forever. Pro is $6.99, once.

records.name: Moonlighter
records.tagline: An AI that does small paid jobs, and says it's an AI
records.description: Moonlighter is a public experiment: can an AI (Claude) earn an honest living doing small jobs? You email a request, the AI asks questions, quotes, sends a free preview, and delivers after payment. Data reports on any coin or stock from $2, translations from $2, script fixes from $4, custom Python scripts and Telegram bots from $8. A human owns the accounts; the AI does the work and always says it's an AI. The first 5 jobs are free in exchange for honest feedback.

records.name: WorldLog
records.tagline: Interactive 3D Globe For History, Cities, Food & Daily Games
records.description: Turn world history and travel planning into a hands-on 3D globe experience with WorldLog. Spin the globe to browse history cards featuring five-paragraph stories and cited sources, explore influential historical figures, use AI to dive deeper, plan tailored routes, and uncover regional foods and landmarks—complete with daily trivia, Histoword, home screen widgets, and 5 languages on iOS and Android.

records.name: Leonida Complete
records.tagline: Track your GTA 6 100% run — every collectible, one checklist
records.description: Leonida Complete is a free 100% completion tracker for Grand Theft Auto VI. It turns the game's 35 completion requirements into one interactive checklist, backed by four databases — 293 tracked items: 39 gang operations (31 with written locations), 117 confirmed animals of 255, every published cocaine flamingo location, and 115 named vehicles for the 200-of-277 scanning requirement. Progress saves in your browser — no account, no sign-up.

records.name: Packall
records.tagline: Open Source Software Directory & App Installer for Linux
records.description: Packall is a free, open source desktop software directory for Linux. Browse a curated catalogue of 200+ apps and install, update or remove them with one click, with progress shown in the background. Works with apt, dnf, pacman, the AUR, zypper, Flatpak and Snap.

records.name: Avori
records.tagline: Making Small Businesses Unstoppable with Multiplayer AI
records.description: Give your small team AI agents that can draft support replies, pull Shopify sales into a dashboard, and run recurring work on a schedule. Build and share agents, workflows, dashboards, and apps in one workspace. Choose the model that fits the job or bring the Claude or ChatGPT plan you already pay for.

records.name: Macapp.space
records.tagline: Discover Mac apps & keep track of the ones that matter.
records.description: Never miss a Mac app you meant to try. Mark apps you want or use, group them into collections, and come back to them later. Find the right Mac app for the job, even when you don’t know its name. Browse about 5,000 apps by category or topic, compare alternatives, and check price, macOS requirements and where to get each one on a single page. Makers list theirs for free.

records.name: Seneca Careers
records.tagline: Moneyball for Hiring
records.description: How do you find talent other hiring managers overlook? Bigger firms can outbid you for the obvious hire. A job title can hide what someone has done, and a résumé rarely tells you which decisions were theirs. Seneca Careers helps you find people already doing the job you need, regardless of title. Candidates choose work from their Seneca AI record so you can see which decisions they made and how those decisions turned out. Spot a hire your competitors missed, find value that fits your budget.

records.name: viAct - Data Centre Safety
records.tagline: AI-Powered Safety & Security for Modern Data Centres
records.description: viAct is an AI-powered data centre safety and security platform that transforms existing CCTV into intelligent monitoring systems. Using computer vision, AI video analytics, IoT and smart wearables, it detects PPE violations, unauthorised access, unsafe activities, worker falls and restricted-area breaches. With cloud, on-premise and hybrid deployment options, viAct helps data centre operators improve workplace safety, strengthen security and manage operational risks proactively.

records.name: TOYB Research Lab
records.tagline: Screening before you sign: counted venues, not forecasts
records.description: We count what a site decision actually turns on: venues inside 500 m and 1 km, chain penetration, missing websites, AI search visibility. 90.3M places across 120 cities with two satellite layers. No footfall, no revenue forecasts. Free 14-page Tokyo preview.

records.name: Voltscribe
records.tagline: Accurate transcripts of mixed English and Spanish audio
records.description: Voltscribe transcribes audio and video where people switch between English and Spanish mid-sentence. Upload a recording, switch on Multilingual, and get one transcript with both languages and speaker labels. No language to pick. Built for bilingual podcasters, journalists and researchers. It runs on Deepgram's Nova-3 and takes about 20 seconds per hour of audio. Files up to 1 GB, Word (DOCX) export, and a free plan that includes mixed-language audio.

records.name: SVG Lab
records.tagline: The AI-native design space, with an agent that designs
records.description: SVG Lab is an AI-native design space. Ask SVG Lab Agent for a brand, a poster, an app or a website: it asks one question, then designs the whole thing on your canvas while you watch, from SVG illustrations and lettering to app screens linked into a clickable prototype. Illustrate turns any description into an editable SVG illustration in about a minute. Edit every part by hand, prototype it, share it, and export SVG, PNG, PDF or code. Prefer your own AI? Connect ChatGPT, Claude, Codex or Cursor.

records.name: RLS Self-Check by CapsAGI
records.tagline: Offline checker for wide-open Supabase RLS policies
records.description: I reviewed the migrations of 145 shipped Supabase apps — 16 (11%) had their database wide open: USING (true) catch-alls, policies with no TO clause (anon key in scope), tables with RLS off, and secrets in configs. Paste supabase/migrations/*.sql into one page: it flags permissive policies, missing TO clauses, RLS-off tables and secret-shaped strings, each with a line number and paste-ready fix, plus a 0–100 score. 100% in your browser. No upload, no signup, no telemetry. Free and open.

records.name: Quandle
records.tagline: Free check of what each Vercel deploy newly exposes
records.description: Quandle is a free Vercel integration. After each preview or production deploy it fetches the site from outside, the way a visitor's browser does, and checks for secrets in shipped JavaScript, public source maps, development builds, and CORS, cookie and header problems. It compares with your latest production scan and speaks up only about what that deploy newly exposed. It never sees your source code or env vars. Open-source GitHub Action for other hosts.

records.name: Grok X Growth Blueprint
records.tagline: Turn Grok into your AI secretary to automate X content.
records.description: Turn Grok into your AI secretary and automate your X growth. Stop burning out over blank screens. Use Grok’s real-time X data to systematize ideation, hooks, and carousels into a 1-hour weekly workflow. • Persona & P-C-C-F Prompt Frameworks • Real-Time Trend & Weekly Batch Ideation • Scroll-Stopping Hooks & 8-Slide Carousels • "AI Copy De-Stink" & No-Code Automation

records.name: RibbonWorthy
records.tagline: A gift guide you browse as 3D shelves
records.description: A gift guide you browse like a small shop. Each recipient has a shelf, and about 150 picks stand on it as 3D objects you can turn around. Filter by interest or budget and follow a pick to a retailer. Picks are drawn from established outlets' gift guides.

records.name: Indonesia Business Kit
records.tagline: Indonesian business utilities as MCP tools for AI agents
records.description: Indonesia Business Kit is an MCP server that gives any AI agent seven deterministic tools for Indonesian business work: terbilang, format_rupiah, hitung_ppn, nomor_invoice, jatuh_tempo, normalisasi_hp and cek_format_npwp. Zero dependencies, one Python file, JSON-RPC over stdio, Docker included, and listed on Glama. Every tool is deterministic and testable — no model calls, no network, no API keys.

records.name: AIGradeLab
records.tagline: Every AI tool, tested and graded from A+ to F
records.description: AIGradeLab is an independent AI tools review platform in 10 languages. We test every tool and assign transparent grades from A+ to F based on 5 criteria: UX, Quality, Value, Integration, and Support. - 92 tools profiled with individual pages and scores - 75 in-depth review articles across all AI categories - AI Tool Finder quiz for personalized recommendations - 100% independent — no paid rankings

records.name: GEO Visibility Auditor
records.tagline: Scan any domain for AI crawler & llms.txt readiness
records.description: GEO Visibility Auditor checks whether a domain is ready to be found and cited by AI systems—not classic Google rankings. Paste a URL. You get a scan of crawler policy (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot training vs retrieval), /llms.txt, FAQ/JSON-LD, and answer-style paragraphs, plus a pasteable fix kit you can apply the same day. One free scan. Starter $29/mo, Pro $79/mo, or $19/10 credits via Creem (Merchant of Record). Citation tracking is phase 2. Not ChatGPT Ads, not a full SEO suite.

records.name: App Clone Labs
records.tagline: Original software engineered from familiar product mechanics
records.description: App Clone Labs is a premium software studio for clone-inspired app development, custom SaaS, AI platforms, marketplaces, mobile apps, web apps, MVPs, and dedicated engineering support. The company works with founders, SMBs, funded startups, agencies, and enterprise innovation teams that need original product strategy, admin tooling, QA, cloud handoff, and fast MVP delivery.

records.name: Sofia Public Transport Live
records.tagline: Never wait again on the bus stop
records.description: No more waiting at stops without knowing if or when your bus will arrive! Sofia Bus is a fully Bulgarian public transport app, built with one single goal: to make getting around Sofia a pleasant, fast and modern experience. Our aim is to become the best public transport app in Sofia, and we'd love to hear whether we're getting there :). Sofia Bus is a small, optimized app that does exactly what it was made for: helping you reach any point in the city quickly and easily by public transport.
