records.description: MagecQR lets guests scan a QR code at their table, browse the menu and order from their phone, with no app to install. Orders arrive on the kitchen and bar screens with the table number. Venues keep their existing POS. Self-service setup: Flat fee of €39 per month per venue, no commission per order, no long-term contract, 30-day free trial on the first subscription. Made in Spain, interface in Spanish with an English menu for guests.

records.name: TenderHub
records.tagline: Greek public tenders matched to your CPV codes
records.description: Monitor Greek and EU public tenders from KIMDIS, Diavgeia and TED in one place. CPV matching, assignments, deadlines, an approval workflow and shared files, so an SME can bid on the contracts it would otherwise miss.

records.name: AgentsRoom.dev
records.tagline: Run all your AI coding agents side by side, in one window
records.description: Desktop app (macOS, Windows, Linux) that runs Claude Code, Codex, Copilot CLI and 20+ other agent CLIs side by side, across all your projects. Live status, quota gauges, git worktrees, and a phone app to answer your agents from anywhere.

records.name: Turfogen
records.tagline: Find, book, and play. All in one place.
records.description: Turfogen makes booking sports turfs easier. Find nearby football and cricket grounds, check availability, and book your playing slot without the hassle of calling or messaging multiple venues. For turf owners, Turfogen offers a simpler way to manage bookings, schedules, courts, and their venue operations. Whether you're planning a game with friends or managing a sports facility, Turfogen brings players and turf owners together on one platform. Less time finding a ground. More time playing.

records.name: Chapa Nexus Niomar
records.tagline: Plataforma oficial do Grêmio Estudantil da escola Niomar
records.description: Desenvolvido para conectar estudantes, promover a transparência e facilitar o acesso às ações da gestão. Principais funcionalidades: • Propostas e Acompanhamento • Participação e Suporte • Experiências Interativas • Transparência e Acessibilidade

records.name: Odometric
records.tagline: Car Showroom Software That Tracks Every Rupee
records.description: Odometric is car showroom management software for used-car dealerships in Pakistan. It runs the money on every car: purchase cost, expenses, investor capital and profit splits, instalments and what each unit actually made, all filed under its registration number.

records.name: RemoteWorldwide Extension
records.tagline: Apply faster with autofill, AI answers and job tracking
records.description: Spend less time typing the same answers into job applications. Remote Worldwide’s Chrome extension autofills forms with your saved answers, helps write new responses with AI, scores and saves jobs, and tracks what you send. Pause an application and pick up where you left off.

records.name: imagesmint
records.tagline: Free online image and video tools
records.description: Free image and video tools from Imagesmint: convert, compress, and edit photos, create collages, compress and convert videos, and add audio. PDF and OCR tools included.

records.name: Nanodot (aka Dust)
records.tagline: Watch your music come alive, gain audience in the process
records.description: Give your music a stage, all FREE. Turn your songs into a half-time show. Share the experience in the moment, with complete strangers, because music was meant to bring us together. No sign-up. Upload & connect with your audience. -54+ procedural worlds. No two plays are the same. -Lyrics videos. -One-tap clips & full-video export. Any size at 60 fps, social media ready. -Dust Live. Host private or public listening parties. -Premieres. Debut your track live. Play it right inside Discord.

records.name: Petrel Voyage
records.tagline: One plan for your group trip, built from everyone's bookings
records.description: Group trips get scattered across four inboxes and a group chat. Petrel puts everyone's flights, stays, trains and dinners into one shared itinerary, day by day. Forward a confirmation, upload a PDF, or add a screenshot of the group chat, and Petrel reads it in under a minute. Friends view the trip by link with no account. Costs split across the group, including people who never sign up. Petrel is not connected to your inbox. Your first trip is free.

records.name: IDPhotoSize
records.tagline: Free passport, visa and ID photo tools on your device
records.description: Prepare photos for applications without an account or watermark. Crop, resize, compress, remove backgrounds and arrange copies for printing. Your photos stay private on your device. Choose the requirements for your application and review the result before submitting. Support: support@idphotosize.com.

records.name: BrandsLens
records.tagline: Hear what’s said about your brand before it spreads
records.description: BrandsLens is a media monitoring and brand reputation platform. It watches news, forums, social platforms and look-alike domains 24/7, scores every mention with AI, and routes serious incidents through an escalation workflow with named owners, a four hour SLA and a full audit trail. Draft holding statements with AI, track Share of Voice and media value, and ask your data anything in plain English. Built in Lagos for PR teams, agencies and brands everywhere.

records.name: Frank
records.tagline: Your building project adviser
records.description: Building projects of any scale are complex and often go wrong, with expensive and sometimes devastating consequences. Frank is an AI-powered building adviser that analyses your building project documentation - quotes, scope, and drawings - and checks them against building regulations and good practice. Frank then shows you the red flags and suggests what to do about it. Add your emails, notes and invoices as your project progresses. Frank will advise at every turn grounded in your own data

records.name: Gemstone - Jewelry Shopify Theme
records.tagline: Showcase Every Sparkle with Elegance and Style
records.description: The Gemstone Jewelry Shopify Theme is an elegant and customizable storefront solution designed for jewelry brands, gemstone retailers, fine jewelry boutiques, and fashion accessory stores. Featuring refined layouts, attractive product displays, and flexible merchandising sections, this theme helps businesses showcase rings, necklaces, earrings, bracelets, and gemstone collections while creating a polished online shopping experience.

records.name: Dentiez
records.tagline: Find and compare dentists and clinics across Israel
records.description: Dentiez is a national dental directory for Israel. Search 3,230 dentists and clinics in 110+ cities, filter by treatment or specialty, compare typical price ranges, and read 72,000+ Google patient reviews, plus on-site reviews checked before publication. Doctors who claim a profile go through ownership and license verification. A free, no-obligation form is answered within 24 hours and helps match patients with a suitable dentist.

records.name: Qteros
records.tagline: Free YouTube to MP3 (320kbps) & MP4 (1080p), no sign-up
records.description: Paste a YouTube link or search a song by name to get MP3 at 192–320 kbps or MP4 up to 1080p in your browser. No account, no extra steps. Works with Shorts and YouTube Music links on any device.

records.name: ShrinkBee
records.tagline: Compress photos and PDFs to an exact KB size, privately
records.description: Exam and government forms ask for a photo under 20 KB or a PDF under 100 KB, and most online tools upload your documents to their servers. ShrinkBee runs entirely in your browser: compress images and PDFs to an exact size, make passport photos, resize signatures, merge/split PDFs, cut MP3s, make GIFs and QR codes. Free, no sign-up, no watermark.

records.name: DueEve
records.tagline: Reminders before free trials and renewals charge
records.description: Built for people who remember free trials only after the charge hits. Screenshot an App Store or Play subscription page into DueEve, keep upcoming renewals in a list or calendar, and get nudged before billing so you still have time to cancel in the store yourself. On-device data, no account, no bank link — a pre-charge heads-up, not a spending ledger.

records.name: Cinevo — Your AI Cinema Companion
records.tagline: Your AI cinema companion for movies, shows & anime
records.description: Meet Cinevo, your AI cinema companion. Discover personalized movie, TV show and anime recommendations tailored to your taste, mood and favorite genres.

records.name: Schengen Calculator
records.tagline: Schengen 90/180 day calculator — check your remaining days
records.description: Free Schengen 90/180 rule calculator: enter your trips and instantly see how many of your 90 days you have used in any rolling 180-day period, when days free up again, and your latest safe exit date. Covers all 29 Schengen countries. No sign-up.

records.name: Bake Cosmetics
records.tagline: 8% Glycolic Acid Scrub Soap: Benefits, Uses & Skincare Tips
records.description: Bake's 8% Glycolic Acid Soap with 3% Niacinamide exfoliates and helps improve the appearance of tan and dark spots on underarms, knees & elbows.

records.name: PathPlay
records.tagline: Replay your workout routes and turn them into videos
records.description: PathPlay turns running, cycling, and hiking routes into animated map replays. Choose a map style, add photos from along the way, and bring your replay to life with background music. Export your journey as a video to save or share. Plus, explore all your routes on a world map and see how many laps around Earth your total workout distance adds up to.

records.name: Elektronik Parça
records.tagline: Find drone, 3D printer and circuit board parts
records.description: Elektronik Parça is a Turkish classifieds site for drone parts, 3D printer components, and electronic circuit boards. Search by part number, brand, or device model. Save a search to get notified when a matching listing goes live, or post spare parts with photos.

records.name: FitMyFace
records.tagline: See haircuts and glasses on your own face, free
records.description: A free web tool that shows haircuts and real glasses on your own face. Point your phone camera, pick a cut or frame, see an AI preview in seconds, then save a card for your barber. AI previews are illustrative. 18+. Not available in Illinois.

records.name: HireAsia
records.tagline: Hire vetted talent in Asia
records.description: HireAsia helps US and European teams hire skills-tested, English-fluent professionals in Asia across engineering, design, data, and operations. Tell us what you’re hiring for and which hours you need covered. Every placement includes at least four hours of workday overlap. You can start with a paid trial, and we handle contracts, invoicing, and payouts.

records.name: Airea
records.tagline: Guided breathing, one breath at a time
records.description: Take a short breathing break with Airea. Follow a visual orb, with optional sound and gentle haptics on supported devices. Explore slow breathing, cyclic sigh, box breathing, and more, or set your own rhythm. Try a guided demo at aireabubble.com. Available for iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch, and Apple TV.

records.name: Versor AI
records.tagline: Kazakh and Russian AI agents for chat and phone sales
records.description: Versor AI helps businesses in Kazakhstan answer new leads and reconnect with past customers through AI chat and voice in Russian and Kazakh. Agents reply on WhatsApp, Instagram and Telegram, answer calls, and run win-back campaigns with opt-outs.

records.name: BUY DUBAI
records.tagline: The data layer for Dubai real estate
records.description: Every registered Dubai property sale, read from the Dubai Land Department every morning. A facts cube computes each metric once, for every tower, community, developer and period. A 3D map puts every tower on screen. Dalia, the AI analyst, answers from that data only and hands serious buyers and sellers to a licensed agent on WhatsApp. A RAG library of news, video, podcasts and Reddit feeds the weekly digest. Lead capture built in.

records.name: Click to Transfer
records.tagline: Transfer ownership of Google Drive files in-place or move
records.description: Seamlessly transfer ownership of selected Google Drive files in-place or move them in just a few clicks. Works from "Open with", search results, and scattered files. Click to Transfer is a lightweight, privacy-focused utility for file ownership handovers across different Google Workspaces™ and personal or Google One™ accounts - preserving original file IDs, URLs, metadata, and version history.

records.name: Migraine Nest
records.tagline: Tap to log migraine pain and see how it changes.
records.description: When light bothers you during a migraine, typing out a note can feel like a lot. On Migraine Nest’s dark iPhone screen, tap a head map to mark where it hurts and choose a pain level. Add symptoms or medication when you’re ready. Before your next appointment, open your diary to see what happened first and which possible triggers you want to discuss.

records.name: gemini-pro-mcp
records.tagline: Use your Google AI Pro plan in Claude Code, Cursor & Codex
records.description: Open-source MCP server & Claude Code plugin that connects your Google AI Pro subscription (Gemini, Deep Research, Jules, NotebookLM, Google Flow video) to 7 coding agents with zero Gemini API bill. One-command setup: uvx gemini-pro-mcp setup.

records.name: Cat Translator: Games for Cats
records.tagline: Laugh at your cat's meows, then let your cat play
records.description: A meow translator, cat sounds and 6 games for cats in one iPhone & iPad app. Hold to record a meow and get a playful line in a chat with your cat, answer in meows, then put the phone on the floor for koi, mice, a feather, a laser dot, bugs and birds.

records.name: Diary for Mom
records.tagline: A painted journal where a child writes to Mom.
records.description: Understand, Respect and Love — it's the best way to communicate with your kids. A sunflower seed tucked into a pocket. An apology after a difficult afternoon. A letter for the day your child turns eighteen. Diary for Mom gives these moments a home on a painted lake. A child can send a letter today, let it arrive a little later, or seal it for a date years away. When a capsule opens, daylight comes through the paint and the handwriting appears.

records.name: Meronch
records.tagline: Targeted B2B lead lists, 100 contacts in 24h
records.description: Done-for-you lead lists for agencies and small B2B teams. Tell me your niche; I build it in Clay: companies, decision-makers, work emails with a confidence note, as a CSV. 100 contacts for $250 in 24h. Free 10-contact sample first. One person, AI-assisted.

records.name: Ada
records.tagline: Your team’s memory, across every tool and project.
records.description: Ada is a shared team memory that makes knowledge easy to remember and reuse, across every AI tool, every project and every teammate. What you and your team learn in ChatGPT, Claude, Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and Grok stays in one place, searchable on the web and over MCP, and drawn as a map of what the team has been working on. Find what a teammate already solved, stop re-explaining project context, and onboard people from the work itself. Ada is free during early access.

records.name: Klare
records.tagline: Call an AI tutor who teaches your notes on a whiteboard
records.description: Klare is an AI tutor you can call. Upload your notes or just type a goal, and it builds a course around your exam date, teaches on a live whiteboard, tests you adaptively and re-plans around what you don't know yet. Free to start.

records.name: KeySound
records.tagline: Tactile mechanical keyboard sound simulator for macOS
records.description: Make your Mac sound like a mechanical keyboard. Choose from 10 real switch recordings, blend Click, Body, and Release layers offline, and create custom typing sound packs from text with AI Sound Studio. Runs in the menu bar. Free with 3 AI trial credits; optional $9.99 one-time Pro Pass.

records.name: Junto
records.tagline: The group card everyone signs, no sign-up needed
records.description: Junto is a group card for farewells, birthdays, teachers and retirements. Start a card for free, share one link in WhatsApp, Slack or by email, and everyone adds a message and photo from their phone without an account. The recipient opens a reveal, or you open it together on a big screen. Free up to 10 messages, then a one-time price per card, no subscription. In German, Spanish, Turkish and English, with data stored in the EU.

records.name: A Joyful Christmas Screensaver
records.tagline: Animated Christmas scenes, music and your own greeting
records.description: Animated Christmas scenes, falling snow, traditional piano hymns and a personalized greeting for Windows and Mac. Windows supports one or both monitors and automatic idle activation. Paid app on the Microsoft Store and Mac App Store. iPhone/iPad public releases are coming, subject to Apple review and availability. Android will follow after closed testing and Google Play approval.

records.name: SimpleKPI
records.tagline: KPI dashboards and reports, with AI at the core
records.description: Set your KPIs, bring in data from a spreadsheet or your apps, and see what's moving at a glance. When a number shifts, Kip, our AI, shows you why and can update targets, build reports and change formulas for you. One simple price. No per-seat fees, no AI credits.

records.name: Rami 51
records.tagline: Free multiplayer Rummy 51 in your browser
records.description: Rami 51 is the classic French rummy, free and multiplayer, right in the browser. No download, no sign-up: open a table and play against real players in seconds. Two 54-card decks, traditional rules, daily challenges, and a coach that teaches you the game. Available in 17 languages, with iOS and Android apps for games with friends.

records.name: HVAC Scout
records.tagline: Scan any HVAC unit's label: likely fault + fair local price
records.description: Snap the data plate on any AC, heat pump, furnace or rooftop unit. HVAC Scout reads the make, model, age and refrigerant, ranks the likely causes of the problem, and shows fair local prices to repair or replace, before anyone quotes you. Every unit keeps one record with its service history and reports, from one home to a whole portfolio. For homeowners, property managers and facility teams in the US and Canada. Free to download; $4.99 per report or plans from $6.99/mo.

records.name: World of Sounds: Animals
records.tagline: Real animal sounds for toddlers — no ads, works offline
records.description: Travel the world and discover what animals sound like! 🦁🐘🐧 🌍 Explore a world map: the farm, the ocean, Africa, America, Asia, Europe, Oceania and the poles. 🔊 177 animals: over 140 with their real sound, recorded in nature. 🤫 Silent animals: octopuses, sharks, butterflies… and dinosaurs! 🗣️ Hear each name in English and in Spanish — a fun first step into a second language.

records.name: ASP-RCM Solutions
records.tagline: Outsourced ABA billing for providers
records.description: Revenue cycle management for U.S. healthcare providers. Senior partners on every account. Written SLAs in 90 days. ABA, hospital, behavioral health, and physician group billing.

records.name: Qorvex
records.tagline: every connection you have, on one download
records.description: A free, open-source download manager that splits every file across all your network connections at once. Torrents, browser takeover, video downloads. Windows, macOS, Linux.

records.name: Pagio Store
records.tagline: Sell your PDFs with a hosted shop page
records.description: Pagio Store is a hosted PDF shop. Sign in, upload a document, edit the sales page, and point the buy button at your own checkout URL, such as a Stripe Payment Link or Gumroad. Buyers pay there. After a sale, you send a private download link from the dashboard. The shop includes page colors, a bio, social links, store analytics, and an export of your files. Hosting is $5 a month or $25 a year, with a 60-day trial. You can also license ready-made titles.

records.name: StarCut
records.tagline: AI Video Generator, AI Video Editor, AI
records.description: Turn your footage into videos with StarCut AI. Describe your first cut, refine shots, captions and pacing through conversation, or take control on the online editing timeline.

records.name: Buffalo Rodent Control Co
records.tagline: Rodent Control Buffalo NY
records.description: Rodent Control Buffalo provides professional rodent control services in Buffalo, NY, helping homeowners and businesses eliminate mice, rats, and other unwanted rodents. Our services include thorough inspections, effective rodent removal, entry-point exclusion, and long-term prevention solutions tailored to properties throughout the Buffalo area.

records.name: GalaxyAtlas: Space Exploration
records.tagline: Offline mobile space sandbox with 1000 000 planets
records.description: Travel between star systems, explore planetary surfaces, discover creatures and hidden artifacts, and customize planets. Unlike combat-focused space games, GalaxyAtlas is built around peaceful exploration and discovery. 3D spaceship flight and planetary landings Real catalogue stars and procedurally generated planets. Explore alien worlds on foot. Discover mysterious locations and artifacts. Fully offline - no internet required Completely free no registration needed. Your universe to explore.

records.name: PlayNear
records.tagline: Find people playing sports near you, right now
records.description: PlayNear shows you who's free to play nearby. Pick a sport and how long you're available, and you appear on the map for people around you. Create or join matches, build a weekly team, chat with your group, and find courts and routes. 11 sports, from padel to running.

records.name: Askaboard
records.tagline: A visual way to learn with AI
records.description: Askaboard is a shared board where you learn with your own AI. Connect Claude or ChatGPT, ask about anything (neurons, interference, why the sky is blue), and it explains by drawing animated scenes on the board and talking you through them. You can write and draw on the same board, and the AI sees your work. Web app and desktop app for macOS, Windows and Linux.

records.name: Docsora
records.tagline: Document Workflow Automation
records.description: Simplify document workflows with Docsora. Automate repetitive processes including e-sigantures, document collection,approvals, file transfers, and more, all in one secure workspace.

records.name: Take One
records.tagline: Film one take. Get back a finished short.
records.description: Take One turns one raw talking-head take, retakes and all, into a finished short for Instagram, TikTok and YouTube Shorts. It cuts the mess-ups between words, adds word-by-word captions and builds motion graphics from what you said: mention a dollar figure and the number flips in. Check a storyboard first or turn on Autopilot. Every video comes back in three styles with a post caption for each platform. Your first edit is free.

records.name: Optivian
records.tagline: Your whole stack on one platform
records.description: Apps often end up split across services: frontend in one place, backend in another, database somewhere else. That means separate dashboards and bills for one app. Optivian runs the whole stack on one platform. Connect a Git repo and your frontend, backend, databases, workers and cron jobs deploy together, with preview environments, rollbacks, autoscaling and backups. For developers, agencies and teams running their own apps. Low, usage-based pricing, no hidden charges.

records.name: B2BRated
records.tagline: Compare business software, verified pricing & features
records.description: Make confident software buying decisions without gatekept pricing or sponsored bias. B2BRated compares 3,400+ business tools with every price linked to its original vendor source, side-by-side plan comparisons and written capability standards.

records.name: Pipplee
records.tagline: Turn any WLED LED matrix into a pixel display
records.description: Pipplee plays 12,000+ animations, pixel art, GIFs, scrolling text, clocks, live weather, arcade games and a music visualizer on any WLED 2D LED matrix over Wi-Fi. No coding. Also runs WLED LED strips. Android, iOS, Mac and Windows.

records.name: Cronum Work
records.tagline: A shared memory for you and your AI agent
records.description: Your AI agent remembers things, but you can't see or edit what it keeps. Cronum Work is a memory you share with it: Tasks, Projects, Next and Notes in one app, and one MCP connector for Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, Claude Code and others. Ask what's on today, plan a project with a Gantt chart, log what got done and the next step, so no chat starts from zero. Web, installable on any device, offline-ready. Free to start; Pro €35/year (€19 for good until 30 Nov).

records.name: Keystrip
records.tagline: Every app's menu commands, one click away
records.description: Stop digging through menus or memorizing shortcuts. Keystrip turns the app you're using into a row of one-click buttons, built from its own menus. No setup. Pro adds AI commands, themes and more. Free forever; Pro $15 ($9 at launch). macOS 14–27.

records.name: WhoMyiP
records.tagline: IPv4 & IPv6 Lookup & API
records.description: Gives you the most accurate IPLookup Information. Instantly reveal your IPv4 and IPv6 address with Who My IP. You can track anonymous visitors, detect fraud, enhance security, and improve user experience.

records.name: Finflo
records.tagline: Free Finance, Health, Math & Everyday Calculators
records.description: Free calculators for money, health, math, and everyday life. Explore clear results, practical examples, and the formulas behind the numbers.

records.name: Compound Interest Calculator
records.tagline: Free compound interest calculator for savings growth
records.description: Free compound interest calculator: daily/monthly/yearly compounding, goals, withdrawals, charts—no account.

records.name: Derle: AI Game & App Builder
records.tagline: Make games, apps and websites on your phone or tablet
records.description: Describe it, Derle builds it. Make your own games, websites and apps on your Android phone: write one sentence and Derle's AI assistant builds it with you. Then play it, preview it or install it. Underneath is a real IDE with a code editor, Git and a Linux terminal on the device. Kotlin, Java, Flutter, React Native, Python, Node.js, C/C++, React, Vue and Godot, up to a signed APK. Run AI agents like OpenCode, Claude Code and Codex CLI in the terminal. Easy for people. Powerful for engineers.

records.name: Starzip Live
records.tagline: World's live street cameras on one map — free, no account
records.description: 9,000+ public street, traffic and city cameras from 40+ countries on one map, with local time, weather and good news nearby. Press R for a random camera in daylight now, or type your trip stops to preview each street. No sign-up, no ads.

records.name: Domenu
records.tagline: A recipe keeper for iPhone you can buy once
records.description: Share a recipe from Instagram, TikTok or any recipe site and Domenu turns it into a clean recipe you can cook from, plan your week with and shop for. Free for your first 10 recipes, with no account. Everything else is a one-time purchase or a subscription, your choice. Launch week: the lifetime purchase is $0.99 instead of $49.99 until 30 November.

records.name: Content Design Report
records.tagline: Live content design job market data: pay, AI skills, careers
records.description: A living report on the content design job market, updated daily from real job postings. See what content designers and UX writers get paid, which AI skills employers are asking for, and where people in these roles go next. Built for content designers, UX writers, and the managers hiring them.

records.name: SharpWrite
records.tagline: the AI-native CMS for one-person businesses
records.description: A clean editor, a plain REST API and built-in AI. Start a 7-day free trial on SharpWrite Cloud, or buy a license once and self-host on Cloudflare Workers.

records.name: Grade Predictor by DoMyWork
records.tagline: Know your assignment grade before you submit
records.description: Upload your essay with your brief and marking criteria. Grade Predictor marks it against your own criteria and gives a predicted grade on your country's scale, a breakdown per criterion and the fixes that would raise it. Your first check is free.

records.name: SundayQuill
records.tagline: Weekly AI novels shaped by readers' ideas
records.description: SundayQuill is serial fiction shaped by its readers, with a new chapter each week for every novel. Readers suggest story ideas and back the ones they want; AI writes each chapter from the ideas readers choose. Chapters are written with multiple LLM models and reviewed by AI agents before release. Chosen ideas are credited in the chapter credits, under the name the reader chooses. Chapters 1 and 2 are free; no account needed. Chapter 3 onward is for members at €3.99/month; cancel anytime.

records.name: WeekMate AI Notetaker
records.tagline: Capture Every Discussion, Keep Teams on the Same Page
records.description: WeekMate AI Notetaker captures every meeting conversation, so teams can focus on discussions instead of taking notes. It keeps meeting records, summaries, and follow-ups in one place, making it easier to revisit decisions and keep everyone on the same page.

records.name: TallyMyTax
records.tagline: Free 2026 OBBBA deduction calculators — no sign-up, no email
records.description: New 2026 US tax deductions, calculated in seconds. Free calculators for no tax on overtime (up to $12,500), no tax on tips (up to $25,000), auto loan interest (up to $10,000), the extra $6,000 senior deduction, and the $40,400 SALT cap — plus a Schedule 1-A estimator stacking them up to $36,500. Every figure is checked against P.L. 119-21 and IRS guidance, with plain-English guides and worked examples. No sign-up, no email. General information, not tax advice.

records.name: Whatchya Wanna
records.tagline: Free app that picks your dinner, drinks, night outs for you
records.description: Can't decide? Your personal decision-making app picks at random where to eat and drink, what to do, cook, and watch. Free, and no account needed to start.

records.name: From Zero to Jarvis (ai agent guide)
records.tagline: Build your own Jarvis for $10.99
records.description: The only AI guide where "it works on my machine" means YOUR machine too. 71 pages, 17 chapters, every command copy-paste ready. Build your own Jarvis for $10.99.

records.name: Wavebreak
records.tagline: Four ways to read the live web, without reloading
records.description: Browse with less distraction on Windows, Mac, iPhone and iPad. Switch live pages between FULL, CLEAR, ASCII and DEEP without reloading. Includes ad and tracker blocking, with no product account or subscription. Desktop downloads and Apple App Store editions are linked; features and release status vary by platform. Free to use.

records.name: Doc Analyzer AI
records.tagline: document analyzer, AI analyzer, AI answers, validation
records.description: Doc Analyzer AI is the ultimate tool for reading and understanding long or complex documents. Upload any PDF and ask our advanced AI questions about the content. The app will instantly find the answer, provide a simple explanation, and highlight the exact source quote directly on the document pages so you can verify the information yourself. Perfect for students, professionals, and anyone who wants to save time reading!

records.name: Pizza Board Game
records.tagline: A quick, tactical pizza board game in your browser
records.description: A cozy, quick-to-learn board game on a circular pizza grid. Place double-sided numbered tokens, flip your opponent's toppings, and claim the highest score. Play free right in your browser against smart bots or a friend—no sign-up needed.

records.name: Biz22
records.tagline: A done-for-you one-page website for small businesses
records.description: Biz22 builds a professional one-page website for your small business. You send your details; we build and host it. $99 one-time setup, then a monthly plan from $14.99 with hosting, a free first-year domain and business email on that domain.

records.name: Trust Wallet Clone
records.tagline: Develop a Crypto Wallet with Token Swaps and Web3 Access

records.name: Packlane
records.tagline: Packing lists built from your trip, for the whole family
records.description: Packlane builds your packing list from your trip: destination, length, weather and whether you'll have laundry. Add every traveler, from baby to teen, and sort items into bags. Chargers and other last-minute things get their own checklist on the morning you leave, and a return checklist helps you come home with everything. Free on iPhone, with an optional Pro.

records.name: Cadence by Aizyn
records.tagline: Never let a LinkedIn conversation go quiet. Free.
records.description: Cadence tells you who to follow up with on LinkedIn, and when. It logs your messages as you send them, builds a Today list, and reminds you on the right day. Manual-first: no automation, no bots, your account stays safe. Free forever, no login.

records.name: SmashyKeys
records.tagline: A keyboard playground for babies & toddlers
records.description: A free browser keyboard game for babies and toddlers (roughly ages 1 to 4). Ten play modes: bouncing critters, fireworks, bubbles, a growing garden, alphabet animals with sounds, rockets, paint splats, a playable piano, first words spelling practice, and snow. Every key plays a musical note, with a voice in seven languages. No ads, no accounts, no downloads, nothing collected about the child.

records.name: TikTok AI Checker
records.tagline: Check if a photo or video was made with TikTok's AI
records.description: A free public tool from TikTok: upload an image or video and see whether it was generated or edited with TikTok's AI features. No TikTok account needed. It looks for TikTok's C2PA Content Credentials and VeraDura, an invisible watermark that survives downloads and re-uploads, and when the signal is intact it shows which tool was used. Files are deleted right after the check. Alongside it, TikTok is rolling out Likeness Detection worldwide so creators can find deepfakes of themselves.

records.name: Life Timeline
records.tagline: See your whole life, and your family's time together
records.description: Life Timeline is a free tool that draws your whole life year by year from just your birth date. Add your parents, partner and kids, and see the time you have together on one timeline. No sign-up, and your inputs aren't stored on the server.

records.name: CVBurst
records.tagline: Free CV & resume builder, no sign-up, no paywall
records.description: Create your CV in the browser with a live preview and 22 templates, then download it as PDF or Word for free. No sign-up, no paywall, no watermark, and your CV stays in your own browser.

records.name: SendForever
records.tagline: Run email on your own Amazon SES. Pay once, send forever.
records.description: Transactional and marketing email in your own AWS account, on Amazon SES, with no monthly bill. Domains, templates, scheduled campaigns, activity and alerts, plus an MCP server for AI agents. Pay from $99 once; AWS bills $0.10 per 1,000 emails.

records.name: Palace Memory
records.tagline: Agent memory with 98.7% top-5 recall, no LLM or GPU
records.description: Palace Memory stores conversations verbatim, not as summaries, graphs, or markdown files, and works with any agent. Retrieval uses no LLM, no re-ranker, and no GPU. On LongMemEval it scores R@1 0.915, R@5 0.987, and R@10 0.996, so the right memory is in the top 5 results 98.7% of the time. A recall costs about 1,700 tokens, where others use about 7,000. The site is fully redesigned. Sign up is self-serve, with a 60-day free trial. The core is open source at github.com/AncientiCe/palace-rs

records.name: PLRPowerHub
records.tagline: Ready-to-use digital products for creators
records.description: What PLRPowerHub does: We provide ready-to-use digital products and AI systems that are already functional and built for monetization. Instead of handing you a blank template, we give you a system—like the Problem-to-Profit Builder—that you can launch and start selling with immediately. You focus on distribution and audience, not development and assembly.

records.name: BlackEdge
records.tagline: Market analytics beyond price and trading signals
records.description: BlackEdge helps traders explore the context behind market prices. The platform brings together market analytics and research tools to examine market conditions from different perspectives. Built for traders who want more context for their own decisions, not promises of returns. Available in English and Italian.

records.name: curfewd
records.tagline: Free local parental control CLI & web studio for any router
records.description: Replace $120-$180/yr cloud parental control subscriptions with a 34 KB, zero-dependency daemon that runs locally on your own LAN. Set daily time quotas (like 1h30m/day with midnight auto-reset), overnight bedtime schedules, instant pauses, and a 0.10ms UDP DNS sinkhole for YouTube, TikTok, and Roblox. Works via CLI (human & AI agent ready) or web studio across 7 router adapters: AT&T BGW, OpenWrt, UniFi, ASUSWRT, Netgear, custom shell hooks, and zero-password Universal mode for any router.

records.name: SkillCheatSheet
records.tagline: verified AI skills, or build your own
records.description: A registry of public AI skills, each SKILL.md scored out of 100 by fixed checks, with a step-by-step skill builder.

records.name: Rizz Ipsum
records.tagline: Lorem ipsum in Gen Z, Gen Alpha, Millennial and Gen X slang
records.description: Rizz Ipsum swaps the Latin for slang. Pick Gen Z, Gen Alpha, Millennial or Gen X, choose 1, 3 or 5 sentences, hit Yeet and copy. Free, no signup, no cookies. There's also a free MCP server so your AI tools can use it too.

records.name: SnapSolve
records.tagline: One workspace, one subscription, a growing family of apps
records.description: A growing family of apps with one workspace and a shared subscription. Track forgotten subscriptions with Orizonte, compare phones, cars or places with SideBy, and create invitations and collect guest RSVPs with Rallia. Start in Cockpit. More products can join your plan as the ecosystem grows. SnapSolve is in early beta. Try a real task and help us improve.

records.name: AR Bomb Squad
records.tagline: An AR bomb-defusal game played in your own room
records.description: Become the commander of an elite bomb squad, right in your own room. AR Bomb Squad uses augmented reality to hide bombs in the space around you. Move your phone to search, line up the crosshair, and fire your disarming laser before time runs out.

records.name: Wrenchlog
records.tagline: Simple software for people who work with their hands
records.description: WrenchLog makes vehicle maintenance and small-business management simpler. Track personal vehicle service records with WrenchLog FREE, or manage customers, jobs, estimates, invoices, and payments with WrenchLog PRO Mechanic. WrenchLog PRO Lawn Care adds property management, recurring scheduling, and flexible invoicing. Built for independent operators and small crews, with straightforward features, transparent pricing, and no intrusive ads.

records.name: Haven
records.tagline: Where AI agents find work, hand it off, and show evidence
records.description: Haven is where AI agents find work and collaborate. Discover peers, offer and claim bounded handoffs, preserve checkpoints, and leave attributable evidence. Temporary Worlds make shared work visible to people. Connect through MCP, the SDK, or HTTP. Open source and free to use.

records.name: Brelia
records.tagline: Fresh nail inspiration and beauty ideas for every style
records.description: Discover your next favorite look with Brelia, a beauty and nail inspiration website featuring stylish manicure ideas, practical nail tutorials, and curated beauty articles. From elegant office nails to creative seasonal designs, Brelia makes finding inspiration for your next manicure simple and enjoyable.

records.name: Spam Audit
records.tagline: Check any website against Google's spam policies
records.description: Checks any site against 15 of Google's 16 spam policies, one by one. Every URL is loaded as a visitor, as Googlebot and on mobile and compared, so hacks shown only to Google are found. Each sign shows the page and the fix, and no check is ever shown as clean if it could not be made.

records.name: KTech AI
records.tagline: Apps and custom software from a Brazilian studio
records.description: KTech AI is a Brazilian software studio. Explore Kai, our AI assistant, and Pertin Equipe, a tool for companies to monitor how work computers are used and make that monitoring transparent to their teams. We also build custom software for businesses whose workflows need their own tools.

records.name: Self Sport
records.tagline: Know yourself by your actions
records.description: Self Sport turns the actions that define you & your days into a simple log of focus across life's 12 core areas. The purpose is to broaden your lifestyle, expand your self awareness, and push you to live bigger and more focused on the moments. The record of those moments (pics and details about every day of your year) is pretty damn cool too. Add in seconds, or talk it through and let our AI sort it.

records.name: AI Astro
records.tagline: Vedic astrology, kundli & panchangam with an AI astrologer
records.description: Generate Vedic birth charts (Janma Kundli) and see your lagna, moon sign and dasha periods in one place. Get a personalized daily view: panchangam, planetary transits, Tara Bala and a classical shloka. Ask Astro-Bot, an AI astrologer, questions about your chart and today's sky.

records.name: RiseMore
records.tagline: Your AI marketer: four agents for SEO, GEO, Reddit & Social
records.description: Grow your business with RiseMore, your AI marketer. Four agents for SEO, GEO, Reddit and Social learn your business, discover opportunities, create and publish content in your voice, and track performance.

records.name: Flowy
records.tagline: Rehearse team decisions. Find gaps. Follow through.
records.description: Describe a workflow. Flowy builds a synthetic human-chaos world where teams rehearse decisions, see simulated consequences and find gaps in ownership, information and coordination. Agree a change, record evidence and retry. A workspace owner can approve an email to a teammate with access and one reminder 48 hours after approval if the action remains open. Free preview; full rehearsals are paid.

records.name: RootMention
records.tagline: SEO subscription for every brand. $299/mo, cancel anytime.
records.description: RootMention is an SEO subscription service for product brands, ecommerce stores, SaaS, gyms and local businesses. Each month we publish AI-search content, fix on-page and schema issues, and track how ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini describe your brand. One flat $299 a month, no contract, cancel anytime.

records.name: Waafer
records.tagline: Cheaper event quotes, negotiated by AI
records.description: Upload any event quote or tell us your budget. Waafer's AI finds suppliers in your city, gets them competing and negotiates the price down. Stands, AV, print, staffing, anywhere. Free to start. You only pay 15% of what we save you.

records.name: Telechappy
records.tagline: Telegram Stars, Premium, Steam top-ups and gift cards.
records.description: Telechappy is a storefront for digital goods you can order in Telegram. Browse Telegram Stars, Premium, Steam wallet top-ups and gift cards on the site, then place your order in the bot. You can buy Stars or Premium for yourself or send them as a gift. The bot shows the total and available payment options before you confirm.

records.name: What's my local AI?
records.tagline: Local AI: what fits, how fast, what it costs
records.description: In August, What's my local AI? answered one question: which local models can your machine actually run? v2 answers the next four: how far off the ones that do not fit are, how fast they run, what local costs against GPT-5.5 and DeepSeek, and what to run it on. Detection stays in your browser. No install, no account, nothing uploaded. 90+ Q4 models, Ollama and LM Studio, refreshed weekly. Free and open source.

records.name: AIDE AI
records.tagline: AI grader for handwritten Cambridge & Edexcel papers
records.description: AIDE AI is an AI grader for teachers, schools and academies. Upload handwritten or typed student work, including essays, and AIDE AI marks it against Cambridge IGCSE, O Level, AS & A Level and Edexcel mark schemes, drafts feedback, and the teacher approves every mark. Students practise past papers from a library of about 60,000 Cambridge, Pearson Edexcel and BISE questions, tagged by topic, with answers. Free: 50 pages, no credit card, plus a free grade calculator and worksheet builder.

records.name: Ethvex
records.tagline: One free Discord bot instead of ten
records.description: Ethvex is a free all in one Discord bot that runs a whole server: moderation, AutoMod, tickets, giveaways, verification, welcome messages, reaction roles, levels and server logs, all set up on a web dashboard.

records.name: Your Next Life-Changing Book
records.tagline: Swipe through 1,000+ books to find the one you need
records.description: Pick what you want more of in life: calm, money, love, focus or a better business. Then swipe. Swipe right and you get more books like it, swipe left and it steers away. 1,000+ hand-picked books, each with its big idea and three lessons in a minute, plus one small thing to try. It favours lesser-known books over the usual bestseller lists. Free, no account needed.

records.name: The RigScore
records.tagline: GPU & RAM prices for personal AI labs
records.description: The RigScore tracks US GPU and RAM prices for people building personal AI labs and local workstations. It checks prices every 6 hours, records price history, and scores each product 0-100 so you can tell if a price is actually a good deal, not just a sale. Set a target price and get alerted when it drops.

records.name: Thydo - beat procrastination!
records.tagline: Turn your phone into a procrastination beater
records.description: If you think you’re procrastinating too much, Thydo helps you do something about it. It tracks the apps and websites you use on your computer and alerts you on your phone when you get distracted. See how much time you spend working versus procrastinating on each task. You choose what counts as productive. Track your progress, be honest with yourself, and build better habits based on results.

records.name: Paycheck Calculator
records.tagline: Paycheck Calculator: Take-Home Pay After Tax
records.description: Take-home pay after federal, Social Security, and Medicare tax, plus state tax where modeled. Salary and hourly, all 50 states and DC — no signup.

records.name: Bid N Rank
records.tagline: List products free. Bid for sponsored visibility.
records.description: Bid N Rank is a multi-category discovery platform for products, businesses, and services. Entrepreneurs and creators can submit eligible listings for free across categories such as ecommerce, travel, marketing, education, and software. Listings are reviewed before appearing in the public directory. Businesses can optionally bid for sponsored leaderboard visibility and track their campaigns. Sponsored positions are paid advertising, not independent quality rankings.

records.name: Techyke
records.tagline: 170+ free, private browser utilities with zero file uploads
records.description: Techyke is a free collection of 170+ private in-browser utilities across 10 categories: Converters, Media, Developer, Finance, PDF, Text, Math, Network, and Security. All tools execute 100% client-side using WebAssembly and modern browser APIs, ensuring your sensitive data and files never touch a remote server. No sign-ups, no file upload size penalties, and instant offline performance.

records.name: FollowersMore
records.tagline: Affordable Social Media Growth for Every Platform
records.description: FollowersMore helps creators and businesses order social media growth services across platforms including Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Facebook, X, and Snapchat. Explore services for followers, likes, and views, place orders through a simple dashboard, and get support when you need it. Compare available options and pricing before ordering.

records.name: FillCraft
records.tagline: 2,500 solver-verified polyomino puzzles, zero repeats
records.description: Cover every cell of a weird-shaped floor by dragging out jelly blocks — nothing overlapping, no holes left behind. Easy to pick up, harder to put down. 2,500 levels, every one machine-proven solvable and structurally unique, so you never replay the same floor twice. Later floors fight back: blocks that can't touch their match, cells hiding gems and runes, and a devil who flips the board while you're still thinking. Offline. No timer. No account.

records.name: СічВовк
records.tagline: Ukrainian Telegram bot: moderation, RP & Kobzar
records.description: Ukrainian-first Telegram bot for chat communities: auto-moderation & anti-spam, marriages & RP commands, chat statistics, an offline "Kobzar" poet quoting Shevchenko, and a GRAM/TON wallet with Stars top-ups. Український бот для чатів: модерація, антиспам, шлюби, RP-команди, статистика, Кобзар і гаманець у GRAM.

records.name: Povura
records.tagline: Create AI images, edit photos, and generate videos
records.description: Povura is an all-in-one AI creative studio for making and editing visuals in the browser. Generate images from text, create professional headshots and avatars, remove backgrounds and objects, enhance or restore old and blurry photos, and turn ideas into short videos. It is built for creators, marketers and anyone who needs polished visuals without design software. Start with 10 free credits every day; optional paid plans are available for more.

records.name: Secret Weaponz
records.tagline: Bring a record. Leave with a weapon
records.description: Not another text box and a prayer. Decks that answer back. Drop a track on Deck A, shape it with eight style pads, and a new track lands on Deck B. Jam it in LIVE mode on 16 tempo-locked pads and record the run, then finish it in a studio you play, not just click: stems, drum machine, sampler, synth, mastering. Less Clicks More Hits.

records.name: Muchhad Quiz
records.tagline: Kahoot killer: Free, no-signup live quizzes for 150+ players
records.description: Kahoot costs $120+/yr, caps at 50 players, requires accounts. Muchhad Quiz is 100% free forever - no limits, no paywalls. Create a quiz, share a 6-digit code, players join instantly with cartoon avatars. Unlimited players (tested 500+), zero friction, works on any device, real-time leaderboard, CSV export, 10k+ quiz library. Built by a teacher, for teachers. No VC. No tracking. No ads. Try free → muchhad-quiz.cc.cd

records.name: BangerClip
records.tagline: Talk for a minute, get a finished reel
records.description: BangerClip turns a one-minute voice recording into a ready-to-post reel: subtitles, animated graphics, music, your photo and brand colors, plus captions for every channel. It renders locally on your Mac. No camera, no editing. Free to start.

records.name: Launch Videos
records.tagline: Turn your website into a launch video in under an hour
records.description: Send your website URL and a song. We turn your real product into a cinematic launch video: 1920×1080, 60 fps, cut to the beat. Done for you, usually ready within an hour. Perfect for Product Hunt, X and your landing page.

records.name: Tastefinder - Swipe movies & TV shows
records.tagline: Swipe titles, get picks that actually match your taste
records.description: Tastefinder helps you find your next movie or TV show in seconds. Swipe titles (like, super-like, dislike, skip) and your feed learns what you enjoy. What's new since our first launch: • Fully redesigned site • Retuned recommendations: strategy settings recalibrated on real user data • TV tracker: mark episodes and seasons, keep track of your shows • Taste Passport: compare your taste with friends • Guess Game • MCP server: use Tastefinder from Claude and other AI assistants

records.name: Redshift: Idle Space RPG
records.tagline: Text space RPG where mission reports travel at light speed
records.description: Redshift is an idle RPG told through text and telemetry. Send uncrewed probes into a galaxy built from your own seed. Missions run on the real clock, and results travel back at the speed of light, so the farther the system, the longer you wait to read what happened. Survey worlds, catalog alien species, name the systems you chart and upgrade eight modules. 40 systems are free, one purchase opens all 120. No ads, no subscription, no account.

records.name: IGspy
records.tagline: Instagram competitor analysis with AI, for Brazil
records.description: IGspy is a Portuguese-language tool for Brazilian Instagram creators. Point it at the accounts growing in your niche: it reads up to 50 posts from each, transcribes the reels and shows which hooks, formats and topics beat the account's average, with the post behind each pattern. Then it writes reel and carousel ideas in your own voice and keeps a niche playbook that grows with every analysis. It does not schedule posts. Free trial, no credit card.

records.name: Astrogra
records.tagline: AI astrologers that read your actual birth chart
records.description: Free Kundli in 30 seconds, computed with Swiss Ephemeris. Then chat or voice-call one of 23 AI astrologers, each trained in a tradition (Vedic, KP, Lal Kitab, Tarot and more), who answer from your real chart rather than your sun sign. Free to start, with no sign-up for the Kundli and no gemstone upselling. Paid packs for more questions and minutes.

records.name: Fieldwell
records.tagline: Simple AI tools for small and multi-unit operators
records.description: 19 simple AI tools for small business and multi-unit operators. Catering math, menu profitability, P&L reviews, SOPs and review replies, with plain-English answers in seconds. No account, no subscription. Pay once, from $49.

records.name: PerfOS
records.tagline: AI that creates, launches and optimizes your Meta Ads 24/7.
records.description: PerfOS turns a short brief into ready-to-run Meta ads: images, copy and ad sets for Facebook and Instagram. It publishes them, watches results every day, pauses ads that don't work and collects leads. For small businesses and agencies. Fire your agency. Hire PerfOS.

records.name: VideoThumbly
records.tagline: AI YouTube thumbnails designed from your actual video
records.description: Upload your video and VideoThumbly scans it start to finish, works out the topic, story and hook, then designs 3 click-ready YouTube thumbnails in about 3 minutes, built from your real footage instead of stock scenes. Keep your face exact with Creator Face Lock, match your channel's look with Channel DNA, fix details with AI Magic Edit and tweak every layer in the editor. YouTube-ready exports (JPG under 2 MB). Start free, no card needed.

records.name: AI Web Page SEO Accessibility Audit
records.tagline: WCAG 2.2 checker that goes beyond the W3C ACT rules
records.description: Reports on all 55 WCAG 2.2 Level A and AA criteria. Pages load in a real browser after scripts run, so keyboard, focus, zoom, reflow, text spacing and contrast are checked as visitors see them. Goes beyond the W3C ACT rules, with a fix for every problem.

records.name: Bayt
records.tagline: Listen to international podcasts in Chinese
records.description: Bayt brings international podcasts to Chinese-speaking listeners with natural Chinese audio and synchronized bilingual transcripts. Switch between Chinese and the original recording, replay a passage, or follow the discussion at your own speed. Available for iPhone, iPad, and Android.

records.name: Overlap Almanac
records.tagline: Find meeting times that work across every time zone
records.description: Overlap Almanac finds the work hours that overlap between cities around the world. Pick a date and meeting length, and it checks local public holidays — including China's 调休 makeup days — so your meeting doesn't land on someone's day off (or miss that their Saturday is a workday). Search cities by English name, Chinese name or airport code. Plans are shareable by link; no account needed.

records.name: Grip
records.tagline: Beautiful, free & open-source screen capture for macOS
records.description: Grip is a screenshot tool, a screen recorder, and a video editor for the Mac, behind one shortcut. It zooms where you click, smooths your cursor, captions your voice on device, and cuts filler words, so a raw take comes out polished with no editing. Connect MCP, copy an MP4, make a GIF, or share a link your team can leave precise comments on. No subscription, no account, no watermark, and free for use on your wildest ideas (commercial ones too!)

records.name: TaskLoop
records.tagline: Offline-First Task Manager
records.description: Focus on what matters. Lightning-fast offline productivity with secure cloud synchronization.

records.name: paraffinwax
records.tagline: #ParaffinWax_Supplier
records.description: Source fully and semi-refined paraffin wax from a reliable global supplier. Compare oil content, melting points, packaging options, and request competitive bulk export quotations.

records.name: Temprix
records.tagline: Capacity planning for support and ops teams
records.description: Team capacity planning for support and operations teams. Temprix records availability as a fraction, sums it into a coverage number for every day ahead, and tells you before it drops below what you need.

records.name: Screen Time Control
records.tagline: Know exactly how long your kids were on screens today
records.description: Stop arguing over “just 5 more minutes.” Set a daily screen limit for each child, then tap Start/Stop whenever they use the TV, tablet, phone or console. You get a phone alert before time’s up, and the timer stops at the limit. Parents and carers can all sign in with one family login. It tracks and reminds; it doesn’t block devices. S$5 one-time, no subscription.

records.name: Gold Intelligence
records.tagline: The personal assistant for physical gold owners
records.description: Gold Intelligence is a Telegram assistant for people who buy or hold physical gold. It shows the live price per gram and ounce, takes your budget and compares dealers' offers for it, and keeps your bars and coins in one place.

records.name: Dismerge PDF
records.tagline: PDF tools that never upload your file
records.description: Split, merge, crop, rotate and reorder PDFs, or convert images and PDFs, right in your browser. Dismerge PDF has no upload endpoint, so private documents stay on your device. Free, no signup, no watermark.

records.name: Voxa
records.tagline: Push-to-talk dictation for your Mac. $18 once.
records.description: Voxa is push-to-talk dictation for macOS. Hold Option + Space, speak, release, and clean text lands where your cursor is. The AI runs on your Mac, works offline, removes filler words and adds punctuation. $18 once, no subscription, all your Macs. Black Friday: 50% off with code BF50, so $9 for a limited time.

records.name: StrictJson
records.tagline: Turn plain words into strict JSON schemas & prompts
records.description: Describe the data you need from an LLM in plain words. StrictJSON writes you an optimized system prompt, a strict JSON Schema, and ready-to-use validation code for Zod, Pydantic or plain JSON Schema — repaired server-side before you get it, so your code never breaks on almost-JSON again. No account, no API key, 10 free generations a day. Its free companion SchemaBox validates JSON in your browser. Built for developers tired of fixing broken LLM output by hand.

records.name: 20 Questions
records.tagline: An AI hides one word a day. Guess it first, win the pot.
records.description: Every day at 00:00 UTC an AI picks one secret word. Everyone asks yes-or-no questions in one public chat. Each question costs 5% more than the last, and the first right guess wins the pot. If nobody gets it by midnight, everyone is refunded in full.

records.name: Tiny Doors
records.tagline: A personalised advent calendar inside a tiny 3D village
records.description: Fill a tiny 3D Christmas village with your photos, notes, vouchers and mini games, then send one link. A new door opens every day in December. No app or account needed to open it. Two worlds are free, and a A$6.99 Season Pass unlocks seven more.

records.name: GTA6 People
records.tagline: GTA 6 characters, voice actors, and stories
records.description: GTA6 People is a fan-built GTA 6 character reference. It started with one search, “mandy gta,” and grew into one page per character, with voice credits, relationships, and locations. It’s an unofficial project with no affiliation with Rockstar or Take-Two.

records.name: Tooty: The Social Fart Map
records.tagline: Drop playful gas pins on a live map with your friends
records.description: Tooty is a free social map app where friends drop playful gas pins, earn XP, climb 8 ranks from Rookie Gasser to Fart God, and compete in leagues. Pick from 10 gas types, add tags, and keep pins public, friends-only, or private. A safety radius keeps exact home addresses hidden. Available in 20+ languages on iOS and Android.

records.name: PRO SOLUTIONS ERP
records.tagline: One system for the whole school, with a free school website
records.description: School and college management system from Mysuru, India. A built-in Teaching Board for lessons, AI that drafts question papers and lesson plans (teachers review), and automatic absent alerts, fee reminders and daily briefings. Apps for parents, teachers and bus drivers with live bus location. Includes a free school website with an admission assistant in English and Kannada. Free data import and training.

records.name: Findable – Speaker & TV Finder
records.tagline: Bring hidden AirPlay speakers and TVs back to your iPhone
records.description: Some speakers, soundbars and TVs keep working but drop out of AirPlay. Findable scans your Wi-Fi, finds the hidden ones and puts them back with one switch. iPhone, iPad and Mac. No account, no data collected. Try free, pay once.

records.name: Exam Briefs
records.tagline: Exam news, results and updates for Indian students
records.description: Exam Briefs brings Indian students the latest exam notifications, results and key updates in short, easy-to-scan briefs. Stay on top of what matters without the clutter. Built by The Bulletin Briefs.

records.name: Dealizard Deal Checker
records.tagline: Find out if a "deal" is real or not
records.description: Paste a product link and we'll check its price against a year of history and use AI to determine whether it looks legit or fake.

records.name: Good Bunch
records.tagline: Free sign-up sheets with no ads or accounts
records.description: Make a sign-up sheet for a potluck, volunteer shifts, a meal train or a class party in about a minute, then share one link. People sign up from their phones without an account, get a reminder the day before, and never see an ad. Every feature is free.

records.name: ReviewMD
records.tagline: Review AI edits to Markdown, one change at a time
records.description: Your AI just rewrote a Markdown file. What changed, and what should you keep? ReviewMD is a native Mac editor that shows what AI and other tools added, removed, or rewrote. Accept, reject, or edit each change in the Review Center. Save a snapshot before a big rewrite, compare versions, and restore an earlier version when you need it.

records.name: Orqella
records.tagline: Build it with AI. Use it anywhere
records.description: Your agent writes a localhost-served webapp module. Your machine runs it. You open it within a single dashboard from a browser, desktop app, phone, or another Orqella machine over an encrypted direct path - no public ports, no VPN.

records.name: Knyte
records.tagline: Shared context for student groups and their AI assistants
records.description: Knyte gives your seminar group one shared memory. Sources, decisions and open questions live in one place, and each member's AI assistant (Claude, ChatGPT and others) reads from it through an assistant-neutral connector. Keep writing in the tools you already use.

records.name: SaveKite
records.tagline: Save TikTok, Douyin & Instagram videos, no watermark.
records.description: SaveKite lets you save public videos from TikTok, Douyin, Instagram Reels, Facebook and Bilibili in HD, without the watermark. Paste a link, pick the quality, download. No app, no sign-up, and nothing is stored on our servers. Works on iPhone, Android and desktop, in English, Vietnamese, Chinese, Indonesian and Thai. Made for creators and anyone who wants to keep a clip they love offline.

records.name: Lovora
records.tagline: A private world for couples
records.description: Messages, calls, synced film nights, a shared gallery, a built-in browser, AI research, memories and daily rituals — all in one private place built for exactly two people. No feed, no followers, no social validation, no ads.

records.name: InterAgent
records.tagline: Real-time AI assistance that helps you respond confidently.
records.description: An AI interview assistant for live interview audio, question understanding, and contextual answer assistance on Windows.

records.name: Screentrino
records.tagline: App Store and Google Play screenshots, styled and shipped
records.description: Screentrino is a browser-based app store screenshot tool that turns raw mobile screenshots into localised App Store and Google Play screenshots, then uploads every required size directly to both stores. It also makes header and search artwork, app icons (draw your own or with AI), matching splash screens and promo videos. No manual resizing. No ZIP handling. No uploading images one by one.

records.name: workersX
records.tagline: Tailor your resume to each job and track every application
records.description: Paste a job posting and compare it with your resume. Review suggested edits, create a tailored cover letter, and track the application in one place.

records.name: Speclr
records.tagline: The AI-guided spec-driven development tool for teams
records.description: Speclr guides your whole team from a vague product idea to sprint-ready BDD specs that developers and coding agents can build from. Instead of generating a spec from one prompt, an AI interviews you and your stakeholders using story mapping, example mapping and 3 Amigos. Domain knowledge persists across sessions, perspective agents review for risk, QA and security, and specs export to GitHub, GitLab or Jira. Runs in your browser: no terminal, no separate AI subscription.

records.name: Krrid Academy
records.tagline: Live Chess Coaching for Kids, Beginner to Advanced
records.description: Krrid Academy is an online chess learning platform offering live, structured coaching for children aged 4-18. Learn through personalized 1-on-1, Buddy, or small-group classes with experienced coaches and a structured curriculum from beginner to advanced. Build chess skills, critical thinking, focus, and confidence.

records.name: Onepard Chat Actions
records.tagline: Let customers use your website just by asking.
records.description: Onepard learns what customers can do on your website. They ask in chat, Onepard handles the request on your site, and they get the result in the same conversation.

records.name: Steerify
records.tagline: Steer Claude Code like a captain, from a board
records.description: Steerify is a free, open source Mac app for steering Claude Code. Your roadmap sits next to the sessions doing the work. Claude asks with pictures before it builds; you pick, look and say ship. Pin a note on a screenshot and it goes back to the session that built it. Not only code: Tasks run your reports on a schedule. New: an iPhone companion in private beta, for steering from the sofa. Someone has to hold the wheel. Congratulations, it's you.

records.name: Eachrole
records.tagline: Your job search, sorted: fresh jobs, Autofill, referrals
records.description: Ghosted again? It's not you, it's hiring. Eachrole finds fresh jobs on employers' own career pages, shows the salary, autofills the application form in 1 press, tailors your resume for up to 25 jobs at once, and shows who to reach. Plus a free referral network.

records.name: CertWatch
records.tagline: SSL & Domain Expiry Monitoring for Agencies
records.description: Monitor SSL certificates, domain registrations, APNs, and SAML certs across all your clients. Detect failed renewals before they cause outages.

records.name: Tellfold
records.tagline: See how people react to your news before you send it
records.description: Paste an announcement and ask a question. Tellfold builds a crowd of AI people who argue about it on a simulated social network, then writes an answer that cites their posts. Free Mac app with no account or server. It runs on AI tools you already have.

records.name: Spa Escape Essential Oil Duo
records.tagline: Lavender and bergamot essential oil duo
records.description: Rootsar Spa Escape is a duo of lavender and bergamot essential oils, pairing floral lavender with citrusy bergamot. Made for aromatherapy, home fragrance and DIY self-care projects.

records.name: Backforms
records.tagline: Multi-Channel Headless Form Backend
records.description: Multi-channel headless form backend for developers. Collect form submissions, block spam with honeypots and Cloudflare Turnstile, sync directly to Google Sheets, and alert your team via WhatsApp, Slack, and Discord.

records.name: Ownback
records.tagline: Own What You Buy
records.description: Ownback puts a small share of every purchase into the companies behind it. Snap a receipt, or let Gmail find it, and 5% goes into USDC jars on Arc. A private AI model reads the receipt and splits it: the maker (Apple), the companies behind it (TSMC, Qualcomm) and the raw materials (gold). When a jar is full, you see the price and fees, then approve. Real tokenized shares land in your own wallet. Nothing buys without your signature.

records.name: Banger Bingo
records.tagline: A music trivia party game for your next game night
records.description: Banger Bingo is music bingo for living rooms. The TV plays a hit and everyone guesses the title, artist, decade or year on their phone. No app or account for players: just scan a QR code. Songs from the '60s to today, 2 to 12 players, free in early access.

records.name: SPIREX
records.tagline: A focused, open-source Scrum workspace, self-hosted or cloud
records.description: SPIREX is a free, open-source alternative to Jira: sprint boards, backlog, epics, custom workflows, time tracking, reporting, full-fidelity Jira import, and AI that drafts tickets by text or voice. Built-in service monitoring alerts the right people when something goes down and powers public status pages for outages, known issues and planned maintenance.

records.name: Vectrox
records.tagline: Renewal tracking and client timelines, no per-user pricing
records.description: Vectrox tracks every contract to its end date and reminds the client 30 days ahead from your own mailbox, scores each client's risk nightly, and files email and meeting debriefs on one timeline. One plan, unmetered team access.

records.name: Noelist
records.tagline: Free Secret Santa and Christmas lists, no ads
records.description: Draw Secret Santa names with exclusions, keep wish lists, and claim gifts without the person seeing. Nobody sees who drew whom, not even the organizer; if someone drops out, it fixes the draw. Free, no ads, English and French.

records.name: Eurorack JS
records.tagline: Build, save and share modular synth patches in your browser
records.description: Sign in with Google or an email link to save your patches. Keep a patch private or publish it to the gallery. Anyone with the link can play it and make their own version, with credit to the original creator. Experimental WebMCP lets compatible AI tools connect modules and measure audio in the open rack.

records.name: 1RM Tools
records.tagline: Estimate your 1RM and plan your training weights
records.description: 1RM Tools offers free strength-training calculators. Estimate your one-rep max, compare Epley and Brzycki, calculate training percentages, and check plate loading and warm-up weights in kg or lb. Mobile-friendly, with no account required.

records.name: CompressGIFs GIF Compressor
records.tagline: The GIF compressor that hits your exact target size
records.description: CompressGIFs shrinks GIFs to the exact file size you need. Pick a target or a preset like Discord emoji, Discord sticker, Slack emoji or WhatsApp, and it finds the right settings automatically, with no guess-and-check slider. Batch a whole folder for free with no file limit. Also resizes GIFs, checks them against platform rules, and converts to WebP. Everything runs in your browser, so your files never leave your device.

records.name: Avenlo
records.tagline: Find B2B prospects and send researched emails from Gmail
records.description: Avenlo finds companies that fit your offer, identifies a relevant contact with a verified work email, and drafts a personal introduction based on company research. Review the research, edit the email, and approve it before it’s sent from your Gmail.

records.name: YouTube Transcript API/MCP
records.tagline: Let Claude, ChatGPT and your code read any YouTube video
records.description: Give your AI a YouTube tool. Connect Claude, ChatGPT, Grok, Cursor, OpenClaw or n8n to one MCP URL and ask about any video: it reads the real transcript, finds the exact quote with its timestamp, and checks what a channel posted this week. Developers get the same transcripts from a REST API as JSON, text, SRT or VTT. 100 free credits, no card.

records.name: BuilderBee
records.tagline: Tech events for women and non-binary builders, worldwide
records.description: BuilderBee is a free calendar of tech events for women and non-binary people: hackathons, buildathons, workshops, meetups and conferences, online and around the world. Made by @irina_csapo and @tracey_windsor after meeting at a hackathon and then struggling to find the next one. An AI scout built with Claude Code adds confirmed events every morning. Add it to your own calendar, get the weekly email every Monday, or find a group to join on the Communities page.

records.name: AegisDatastra
records.tagline: Enterprise GRC meets AI Trust Orchestration
records.description: AegisDatastra unifies automated enterprise GRC with AI and agent governance. Trace business intent through processes, policies, controls, systems and data lineage. Govern and test controls from planning through in-flight operations to production execution. Connect risk, compliance, audit, human approvals and AI guardrails to continuous, tamper-evident evidence, without replacing existing systems or copying enterprise data.

records.name: Perplexity Monitor API
records.tagline: A web watchdog for agents that only pings on real changes
records.description: Monitor API watches the web for you and calls your webhook only when something relevant happens. Web Monitor runs a query through Perplexity Search on a schedule. Page Monitor tracks up to 10 pages (pricing, changelogs, policies) and returns a text diff. A decider model checks each result for relevance, source quality, novelty and freshness before it reaches you. Runs every 15 min to weekly or on cron, deduped across runs. $1 per 1,000 runs, same key as the Search API.

records.name: Fleetify
records.tagline: Open-source command center for your AI coding agents
records.description: Fleetify is a free, open-source desktop app for running AI coding agents side by side. Start sessions with Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode and seven more agents, or with OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, OpenRouter and local Ollama models. Watch them all from the Fleet hub: status, spend, tokens and live activity. Give each task its own git worktree, preview your dev server, open PRs, and install a plugin once for every agent that supports it. macOS, Windows, Linux.

records.name: Sottena
records.tagline: Real-time AI interview copilot with answers from 300 ms
records.description: Sottena listens to your interview call and streams answer points: ~300 ms in fast Turbo, ~1 s in the smarter standard mode. The Arbiter prompts you while you answer, live coding works from a screenshot, the window stays hidden on screen share. From $15.

records.name: Weave My Resume
records.tagline: Tailor your résumé to one job description, with an ATS check
records.description: Weave My Resume tailors your résumé to one job ad. It rewrites your lines in the employer's own language without inventing anything: a five-stage check blocks invented tools, credentials, numbers and seniority. You get an ATS-ready résumé with a before-and-after match score, and an optional interview pack. In beta: honest reviews, good or bad, welcome.

records.name: Retrovise
records.tagline: Step into the moment. There is more beyond the frame.
records.description: Turn a photo into a saved 3D world you can explore on Android or in VR. Retrovise adds a QR code to the photo. Scan it on paper or on a screen to reopen the same world. AI imagines what lies beyond the frame. In supported worlds, describe something you remember by voice or text and preview it in the scene. Your original photo stays intact.

records.name: Keymorph
records.tagline: Keyboard + mouse → PS5/Switch controller, no hardware
records.description: Maps your keyboard and mouse to a virtual PS4/PS5/Switch controller on Windows — no USB adapter needed. Uses ViGEm (same driver as DS4Windows) to present a fake gamepad to Windows. Games, PS Remote Play, and Xbox Cloud Gaming see it as real hardware. Bind any key or mouse axis to any controller input. Configurable sensitivity curves and deadzones handle mouse-to-analog translation. Switch profiles with a hotkey. Free tier: 2 profiles. Full: €14.99 one-time.

records.name: LocalServe
records.tagline: Turn any folder on your Mac into a local website
records.description: LocalServe turns any folder on your Mac into a website you can open in a browser — no terminal, no cloud. Pick a folder, start the site, and give it a memorable address like myapp.ls. Scan a QR code to open it on your phone. Add proxy rules so frontend and backend talk without CORS issues. Share files on your Wi-Fi the same way. Made for vibe-coded web apps, local previews, and tools you want to keep running. 7-day free trial. $9 lifetime license for 3 devices. Runs locally. Collects nothing.

records.name: Reap
records.tagline: Clean up processes your AI coding agents leave behind
records.description: Reap is a free, open-source menu bar and system tray app for macOS and Windows. It finds leftover dev servers, file watchers, and browser processes after Claude Code, Codex, or Cursor sessions end.
