See what’s still using memory or holding ports, stop leftovers by session, and reclaim disk space from stale worktrees and caches. Everything runs locally. Cursor support is experimental.

records.name: Studiora: Focus Timer & Sound
records.tagline: Focus timer, ambient sound & rituals — no subscription
records.description: Studiora pairs a calm countdown with 89 ambient sounds you mix yourself. iPhone and iPad: six modes, multi-stage rituals with a sound per stage, a Sounds tab, and insights that show your records without productivity claims. 73 tracks free forever. Lifetime Pro adds 16 more — one purchase, no subscription, no trial. No ads, no account. Data stays on device. Not a medical device. Ambient audio is atmosphere, not a treatment. https://apps.apple.com/us/app/studiora-focus-timer-sound/id6751479847

records.name: CRAMA FILE
records.tagline: Free PDF & image tools that never upload your files
records.description: CRAMA FILE is 21 free PDF and image tools that run entirely in your browser. Merge, split, compress and reorder PDFs, turn photos into a PDF, convert PDF to JPG, PNG or PowerPoint, and convert HEIC, WEBP, PNG and JPG images. Your files are processed on your own device and never uploaded, so it is safe for contracts and ID scans. No sign-up, no payment, no watermark, no limits. Open a tool, turn off Wi-Fi, and it still works.

records.name: PenPal
records.tagline: A free digital business card. No app needed to receive.
records.description: Networking got harder in the age of AI. Inboxes overflow with AI-written outreach, so the real conversation you have in person matters more, and it's the easiest to lose. PenPal makes that hello count: digital business cards shared via NFC tap or QR code, with lead-capture forms and a contact list. Opens in any browser, no app needed. Free to start, with an optional printed NFC card.

records.name: Stashio
records.tagline: Offline Android photo vault with decoys and a duress pattern
records.description: Stashio encrypts photos, videos and documents on your Android phone and opens with a pattern on a 5×5 grid. A different pattern opens a decoy vault. A duress pattern opens a harmless vault and deletes the keys to all the others. There's no account, no server and no internet permission, so Android itself keeps the app offline. Every security feature is free, for 2 vaults with 100 files each. Pro adds 2 more vaults, unlimited files and a plain home-screen icon.

records.name: Smokoff
records.tagline: Quit smoking or vaping with friends. Free, no ads
records.description: Most quit smoking apps count your days, then lock the useful parts behind a subscription. Smokoff is free with no ads, and built around quitting together. • Challenge a friend to a duel: pick the length, the stakes, and see who stays smoke-free longer • Community chat in your language for when cravings hit • Works for cigarettes, vapes, hookah, heated tobacco and roll-ups • Money saved, health timeline, craving diary, breathing exercises • iPhone, Android, Apple Watch, Wear OS. 46 languages

records.name: Supercharged Email Free Tools
records.tagline: Free email marketing tools for small businesses, no signup
records.description: A free toolkit for small business email marketing: subject line generator and tester, spam risk check, email signature generator, send schedule planner, newsletter ideas, and welcome, re-engagement and abandoned cart email generators. No signup required. Made by Synergy for small businesses on Constant Contact.

records.name: MemoMori
records.tagline: Markdown notes your AI can read and write
records.description: MemoMori is a Markdown editor in your browser that keeps notes as plain files. Draw with Excalidraw, link or embed any note or file, and rename freely: every link follows. Roll back any note to an earlier version. Connect Claude Code, Codex, Cursor or any MCP client, and your AI can search, read and write your notes. 2 GiB free, no card. Pro adds 50 GiB, MCP and API keys, share links and a year of history. Pro is $40/year until Dec 31.

records.name: Creorank
records.tagline: Get your product listed and discovered by the right audience
records.description: Building something worth discovering shouldn’t mean paying to compete for visibility. Creorank gives startups, products, websites, services, and creators a dedicated space to showcase their work and get discovered through interest-driven browsing. With optional fixed-price promotions, an ad-free experience, and real-time listing analytics, you can focus on what matters: getting your work in front of the right audience. No bidding wars. No upvote exchanges. No ads. Just discovery.

records.name: Batteram
records.tagline: Bulk API calls from a spreadsheet — no bulk endpoint needed
records.description: Many web apps and internal admin panels never shipped a bulk endpoint. Batteram takes one request template — method, URL, headers, body with {{column}} placeholders — and replays it for every row of your CSV. Dry-run the first row, then run the file with a concurrency cap and interval. Response assertions catch silent 200s, results come back row by row, and you retry only the failed rows before exporting to CSV or JSON. Runs entirely on your machine: no cloud, no telemetry, no data uploads.

records.name: Nityasha — AI Day Planner
records.tagline: Your day, replanned automatically when it falls apart
records.description: Nityasha is an AI day planner that assumes your day will not go to plan. It builds the day around your energy: deep work in your peak window, admin in the dips, real breaks in between. When a meeting overruns or you skip a block, it rebuilds what's left instead of leaving a hole. Edits you make by hand are never overwritten. Every morning starts from a plan you can actually follow, not a list to feel guilty about. Free on Android. No account needed to try.

records.name: SteamScout
records.tagline: Find profitable Steam indie game niches with real data
records.description: SteamScout tracks 118,000+ live Steam games to help indie devs discover blue-ocean niches, analyze 2-tag combos, benchmark pricing, and estimate revenue with a calibrated 2026 Boxleiter model. It also includes 30 free, no-login browser tools under /dev: 14-region pricing (with Poland PLN fix), 30-day discount cooldown planner, W-8BEN tax & publisher deal calculators, local capsule resizer/previewer, BBCode editor, SteamPipe VDF generator, and a Verified No-AI tracker.

records.name: ChargedClipper
records.tagline: AI Video Clipper
records.description: ChargedClipper turns long videos into viral short clips in minutes. Paste a YouTube, Twitch, or Drive link and AI finds the best moments, cuts them into 9:16 vertical clips, and adds styled captions automatically. Built for creators, podcasters, and streamers who want to grow on TikTok, Reels, and Shorts without spending hours editing. Free plan included.

records.name: Advent Journey:Advent Calendar
records.tagline: Daily Devotional & Prayer
records.description: Prepare your heart for Christmas, one day at a time. Advent Journey is a daily Advent calendar centered on Jesus and welcoming Christians across denominations. Open a door each day to a short Bible reading, a reflection, a prayer, and one small action to put your faith into practice. A DAILY MOMENT WITH JESUS • Read a short Scripture passage with a thoughtful reflection. • Pause for prayer at your own pace. • Carry your faith into the day with a simple action.

records.name: RandomTools
records.tagline: 37 free browser tools that never upload your data
records.description: Word counter, JSON/SQL/YAML formatters, regex tester, image converter, calculators, unit converters and random pickers: 37 free tools that run entirely in your browser. No sign-up, and nothing you type or upload is sent to a server. Each page explains exactly how its tool works and its limits.

records.name: 7 Deadly Sins Test
records.tagline: Which of the seven deadly sins shows up in your choices?
records.description: How do you react when a teammate gets the credit? Answer 25 everyday dilemmas in about three minutes and get a percentage for each of the seven deadly sins.

records.name: Trylet
records.tagline: One small fitness challenge at a time, no streaks
records.description: Trylet gives you one small fitness challenge at a time: a minute of squats, a plank, a 1 km run. Do it, write down your number, and see how it compares with last time. Every challenge has three levels (Basic, Healthy, Excellent) so your number means something and the next goal is within reach. No account, no subscription, no streaks, no ads. Your results stay on your iPhone and in your own iCloud.

records.name: Velado
records.tagline: Anonimiza contratos, facturas y nóminas en segundos
records.description: Velado anonimiza PDF para gestorías, despachos de abogados y RRHH. La IA detecta los datos personales de nóminas, contratos y facturas (nombres, DNI/NIE, n.º de la Seguridad Social, IBAN, direcciones, teléfonos…), tú revisas cada marca y descargas un PDF con esos datos eliminados de verdad, no solo tapados con un recuadro negro. El PDF se procesa en el navegador. Gratis hasta 5 páginas; planes desde 12 €/mes.

records.name: LayAuto 4
records.tagline: Find any window, tab, or session on your Mac
records.description: LayAuto 4 is a window manager for Apple silicon Macs. Search and jump to any window, browser tab, terminal session, or project; group them by context; restore layouts automatically; and use two Macs as one workspace. Most features are free.

records.name: InField
records.tagline: Translate and refine text where you type, on Mac and Chrome
records.description: Translating something usually means leaving it: open a translator or AI, paste, copy, come back, and paste again. InField skips the trip. Tap Shift twice in any text field on your Mac or in Chrome, and InField translates or polishes what you wrote. Tap Shift once more and replace it. Write in your language, the target one, or a mix of both, and get one clean text. Fix grammar, structure, and tone. Select text to translate it. InField detects the source language for you.

records.name: Bento terminal
records.tagline: A multi-pane terminal workspace for one project
records.description: Bento is a full-screen terminal workspace for one project: preview and edit files, review changes, run builds, open a shell, and run coding agents beside the preview. No more multi-tab terminal juggling — one Bento window holds the workspace, with shell tabs inside. Let your AI agent do the work while you watch changes in real time, see what is staged for git, and run tests while the dev server keeps running. In-app updates. Single Go binary, MIT, macOS, Linux, Windows.

records.name: Scribase MCP Server
records.tagline: A Postgres backend your coding agent sets up by MCP
records.description: Scribase MCP Server gives Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Windsurf, Zed and VS Code 97 tools over a hosted Postgres backend: database, auth, storage, realtime and functions. The agent creates the project, runs SQL and migrations, and writes the keys into your app. Reads run at once; destructive changes wait for your confirm, and schema changes can be gated on a passing row-level-security test. Remote server, nothing to run. Free for 14 days, no card, then from $5 a project.

records.name: mindyOne
records.tagline: Your Instagram DMs. Now with an AI receptionist.
records.description: mindyOne is an AI receptionist for your Instagram DMs. When someone asks for a time, it answers from your prices and hours, offers only slots that are really free, and books the appointment right in the chat: a name, a read-back and a yes. It also reschedules and cancels, says it's an AI, and steps back when you reply. Built for businesses whose DMs end in a booking: trainers, salons, photographers, studios, consultants. Build yours from a description and talk to it before you sign up.

records.name: DeskMagic
records.tagline: Shake your cursor, ask AI about anything on screen
records.description: DeskMagic is a Windows app that puts AI right next to whatever you're looking at. Shake your mouse, drag around a chart, error, email or foreign text, and the answer streams in beside it. Uses your own Claude, ChatGPT or Gemini key with no DeskMagic servers in between, no account, and history saved only on your PC. Highlight text to skip the screenshot entirely.

records.name: TouchDeck
records.tagline: Turn your iPhone or iPad into a control deck for your Mac
records.description: TouchDeck turns your iPhone, iPad or iPhone Duo into a control deck for your Mac: keys, rotary dials, sliders and a jog wheel. Pick any Mac app and it builds a deck from the shortcuts in that app's own menus, and your deck switches by itself when you change apps. One key can run a whole workflow. Pairs with a 4-digit code over local Wi-Fi, end-to-end encrypted, no account. The Mac app is free; 7-day free trial on iPhone and iPad.

records.name: Prime Filter & Price Sort for Amazon
records.tagline: Amazon Prime filter and lowest price first, automatically
records.description: I got tired of clicking the same two things on every Amazon search: the Prime filter and the sort order. This extension applies both before the page loads, so there is one page load. Sort by lowest price or best reviews, or switch sorting off. If you change a filter or the sort on the results page, it leaves your choice alone. Live for Firefox, Chrome and Edge. The Prime filter works on all 19 Amazon sites. No account, no tracking, settings stay in your browser. Free and MIT licensed.

records.name: Round Zero
records.tagline: An AI career coach and specialist team for your next move
records.description: Carmen is an AI career coach who remembers your goal, your background and what you decided last time. Land a new job, change careers, grow in your role or start a business, and she brings in a specialist for each step: strategy, research, résumés and LinkedIn, practice, and hard conversations. Rehearse interviews, reviews, pitches and salary talks out loud, and every score quotes what you actually said. Free to start with 30 voice minutes, no card.

records.name: Convmog
records.tagline: Convert any file on your Mac without letting go of it
records.description: Convmog turns the drag you're already making into a file converter. Hold ⇧ while dragging a file and a glass wheel opens around the cursor with only the formats that file can become: HEIC to JPG, MOV to GIF, PDF to PNG pages, DOCX to PDF. Let go on a wedge and the new file appears next to the original. Add ⌥ for tools such as compress, crop, merge, split and OCR. It runs entirely on your Mac, uploads nothing and costs nothing.

records.name: VoidDrive: AI Car Mechanic
records.tagline: Turn your phone into an AI car mechanic
records.description: VoidDrive turns your phone into an AI car mechanic. Works with any $10-25 Bluetooth ELM327 adapter - no proprietary hardware. • Read and clear every fault code, explained in plain English • AI repair guidance with parts and labor costs for your region • Pre-purchase audit exposes wiped codes before you buy a used car • Live telemetry, fuel economy, trip logs and territory • Voice coach warns of overheating and alternator failure • 18,800+ codes offline. Your data never leaves your phone

records.name: Easy Trip Expenses
records.tagline: Turn business trip receipts into a ready-to-submit report
records.description: Add receipts during your business trip, in any currency, and get a clean PDF or Excel expense report ready for approval. No spreadsheets, no setup. Built for employees, freelancers and small teams. The first trip report is free, then $3.99 per trip or $19/year for unlimited reports. Plus 20+ free calculators: GSA FY2027 per diem, foreign per diem (228 countries), IRS mileage log, meal deduction and more.

records.name: R2Explorer
records.tagline: A native Mac and iPhone client for Cloudflare R2 and S3
records.description: R2Explorer browses, uploads and manages Cloudflare R2 and any S3-compatible storage, natively on Mac, iPhone and iPad, no Electron. Sign in with Cloudflare instead of pasting tokens, see month-to-date cost per bucket, filter across a whole bucket, mirror between providers, inspect R2 Data Catalog tables, and browse a local wrangler dev bucket from disk. Credentials stay in the Keychain. Free for read-only use, Pro is $5.99 once.

records.name: Waypoint: Daily Goal Planner
records.tagline: A day planner that plans around the time you actually have
records.description: Waypoint plans your day around the time you actually have. Tell it your working hours and when you sleep; add a task and it finds a real gap. When two things clash, it says so and offers a way out. Misses stay visible: an undone task never slides to tomorrow on its own, and you can't tick it off a day late. After a couple of weeks it shows which day you deliver on and what you keep pushing back. No account, no server, everything stays on your iPhone. Pro is one purchase.

records.name: Libreta de Gym
records.tagline: A private workout log that stays on your device.
records.description: A private workout log for recording gym sessions and sets, planning routines, and backing up your data as JSON. It is a web app that runs in your browser, and your workout data stays on your device: the app has no account, cloud sync, analytics or AI recommendations.

records.name: Joa
records.tagline: How much money you have, and where it is
records.description: Joa is a personal finance app for iPhone built around one question: how much money do I have, and where is it? Log income, expenses and transfers across your accounts in 31 currencies, keep recurring payments on a calendar with reminders, and let Apple Pay payments log themselves with a Shortcuts automation. No bank connection, no Joa account, no ads. Your data stays on your iPhone and your private iCloud. Free to use, with Joa Pro for more spaces and no limits.

records.name: Burnline
records.tagline: AI coding usage + limits in your menu bar
records.description: Burnline is a native macOS menu-bar app for your Claude Code and OpenAI Codex usage: every 5-hour and weekly limit with reset countdowns and pace warnings, plus what it would cost at API prices, priced at the rate in force that day. A dashboard keeps every day you've coded, by model, project and session, with streaks, 132 medals and fun comparisons. Local-first: no account, no server, no telemetry. Free and open source (AGPL-3.0).

records.name: HeyZima
records.tagline: A Chinese course made for you: read, write, listen, speak
records.description: HeyZima is all of Chinese in one app: reading, writing, listening and speaking, with the dictionary built in. Its course is made as you go: every session is built from the words and grammar you've just learned, the ones you keep missing, and the ones about to slip. You practise on 98,285 real sentences written by people: read them, hear them, say them back and write them in pinyin. It tells you when you'll reach your next HSK level. Ten minutes a day is free. Android now, iPhone soon.

records.name: Oya Browser
records.tagline: A real, logged-in browser for your AI agents
records.description: AI agents break on real websites: they get logged out, stall at MFA, and burn tokens on every click. Oya gives Claude Code, Cursor, Codex or any MCP client a real browser with persistent logins. Watch live and take over for MFA in one click. Record a workflow once, replay it with zero LLM calls, or export it as Playwright code. Scales from 1 to 1,000s of cloud browsers in under a minute, HIPAA compliant on Oya Cloud. Free desktop app.

records.name: Muse to PDF
records.tagline: Save your Muse AI chats as PDF, Word or Markdown
records.description: Muse to PDF adds an Export button to every Muse AI chat. Save a whole conversation or only the messages you tick, as PDF, Word, Markdown, HTML, TXT or JSON. You can export many chats at once too. It runs entirely in your browser, is free, and needs no account.

records.name: VendHub
records.tagline: The Complete Operating System for Unattended Retail
records.description: One platform to win locations, buy machines, and source products. Built by vending operators, for vending operators.

records.name: Sudoku - Endless Logic Puzzle
records.tagline: Good to touch. Good to think. Sudoku with endless puzzles
records.description: A sudoku built around how it feels. Press a cell, slide to a digit, let go: one motion, no reaching for a keypad. Rows, columns and boxes light up as you complete them, and finished digits fly into their key. Ranked Match builds each puzzle on the spot to fit your rating, from Rookie to Legend, even offline. Stuck? Keep the same board with hints that show where to look and name the technique. Every puzzle solvable by logic alone. Free with ads.

records.name: Gender Reveal, Inc.
records.tagline: Turn your gender reveal into a friends & family round
records.description: Launch your baby like a real startup. Create a gender reveal page, add personalized gifts for your little human, and let friends chip in for an early reveal. Everyone else finds out on the public reveal date. Your baby gets the keepsakes. You get a head start. Try the interactive demo and join the waitlist for December 24.

records.name: Train My AI
records.tagline: Training and memory for your AI that carry to every chat
records.description: They say you can't train your AI. Now you can. Give Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini or Grok your own rules, procedures and who you are, one line at a time, plus a searchable memory of dated notes you approve. Your AI reads its training back by itself, so a new chat, or one that's been compacted, carries on where you left off. Works on free plans and with coding apps like Claude Code and Codex. 12 languages. Pay to play, no subscription.

records.name: Învață Limbi Străine
records.tagline: English and Spanish lessons explained in Romanian
records.description: Învață Limbi Străine is a language learning app for Romanian speakers. Learn English and Spanish with grammar and vocabulary lessons explained in Romanian, interactive exercises, A1 to C1 vocabulary, verb conjugations, pronunciation practice and daily progress tracking. Start for free, upgrade to Premium for the full course.

records.name: Neervia
records.tagline: AirDrop for Windows and Android, with a built-in PC remote
records.description: Neervia sends files between your Windows PC and Android phone over your own network — no internet, no cables, no cloud, no accounts. Pair once, then send from Explorer, the share sheet, or a per-device chat thread. Transfers resume if the connection drops. Your phone also becomes a remote for the PC: build your own widget layout for each machine — trackpad, keyboard, media, presentations, even a gamepad. Live on Google Play, the Microsoft Store and GitHub.

records.name: PWR
records.tagline: Build playable games and apps with autonomous AI agents
records.description: Describe a game or app, and let PWR's autonomous AI development team bring it to life. Specialized agents plan the work, write code, test in a real browser, and independently review the results. Preview what they've built, request changes, and publish playable games to a link—or connect GitHub for existing software projects. Set a spending limit before work begins, with transparent usage throughout.

records.name: Clipsmithy
records.tagline: Paste a podcast link, get viral Shorts. Unlimited. $7.99
records.description: Paste a YouTube link to your podcast or stream. Clipsmithy finds the moments that hook, scores them 0–99, writes titles and post captions, follows faces into 9:16 and adds animated captions, ready for TikTok, Reels and YouTube Shorts. Runs on your Mac or PC, so your footage is never uploaded. Unlimited videos for $7.99/mo. 7-day free trial, no card.

records.name: OddForge DataForge PRO
records.tagline: Clean and deduplicate CSV data offline
records.description: DataForge PRO is an offline CSV cleaning toolkit for freelancers, administrators and small businesses. Import and combine CSV files, clean inconsistent text, identify duplicates, review data-quality issues and export results to CSV or JSON. Save reusable cleaning recipes for recurring jobs. Runs in a modern desktop browser without cloud uploads. £29 one-time purchase, no subscription.

records.name: ipify - A Simple Public IP Address API
records.tagline: A Simple Public IP Address API
records.description: ipify is a simple public IP address API that lets you retrieve your public IP programmatically. It supports IPv4 and IPv6, returns plain text, JSON, or JSONP, and can be used without limits or logging.

records.name: multiclaude
records.tagline: Use all your Claude Pro/Max accounts in one Claude Code
records.description: multiclaude runs several Claude Pro / Max accounts in one Claude Code. Each account keeps its own login; history, memory, settings, skills, plugins and MCP servers are shared. Put them in priority order, type claude, and it starts on the first account with room. Live 5-hour and weekly usage in a dashboard, the menu bar, a terminal picker and the status line, with alerts and a one-click move to the next account. Optional API-key fallback. 100% local, free, MIT.

records.name: Resource Pack Studio
records.tagline: Design your Minecraft server's resource pack in the browser
records.description: Resource Pack Studio is a browser design studio for Minecraft Java servers. Draw chest menus that work like a shop, pixel rank tags for chat and TAB, items with their own ID and animation, custom blocks, pixel fonts and your server list entry. Style names and lore freely in MiniMessage, check everything at game size, then build it all into one resource pack that players get when they join. Free for one server, no card needed.

records.name: Yepdid: Tasks for Two
records.tagline: A shared to-do list made for Two
records.description: Yepdid is a to-do list made for two. Give a task to your partner, take one yourself, or leave it for whoever gets there first. Done takes two ticks: one of you ticks it, the other says yep. Free: checklists, busy times side by side so deadlines land when someone is free, reminders and pokes. Yepdid+ adds routines, shared costs with settle up, photos and PDFs on tasks, and Google Calendar sync, with a 7-day free trial. On iPhone now, Google Play coming soon.

records.name: DR4 Checker by Construct Computer
records.tagline: Your Ahrefs DR probably drops on Dec 1. See where it lands.
records.description: Ahrefs switches Domain Rating to DR4 on December 1, and 88 of the 100 sites we checked score lower. Type up to five sites to see each one's DR4 next to its DR3, along with its Tranco rank and trend, domain age, first archived date, Wikipedia links and a malware check. Every number comes live from a free source and says where it came from, and you don't need an account. Agents can call it by URL, use it as a WebMCP tool on the page, or add our MCP server, which has all our free tools.

records.name: Dunoya
records.tagline: MCP connects AI to software. Dunoya connects AI to humans
records.description: MCP connects AI to software. Dunoya connects AI to the real world. AI apps give you a list, then you still call around. With Dunoya, type @Dunoya in ChatGPT, Gemini or Claude and nearby shops, owners and service providers reply live with price, stock and timing, so you choose and go. Businesses join free at dunoya.in/registration, get their own link for Google, and answer from the Dunoya app or their AI app.

records.name: MaiSkill
records.tagline: Learn AI for your work in five minutes a day
records.description: MaiSkill, by Langly Inc, is an app for iPhone and the web that teaches you to use an AI assistant for the work you already do. Each lesson takes about five minutes. You try something real first, then see why it works. You also learn to check answers for made-up facts and to keep private details out of your prompts. Short games, a daily plan and a weekly goal help you come back. No ads and no tracking tools from other companies. Free to start, with a 7-day free trial of MaiSkill Plus.

records.name: iWORKS GLOBAL
records.tagline: Business setup and digital services in one portal
records.description: iWORKS GLOBAL helps entrepreneurs and businesses access registration, compliance, trademark, website development, hosting, and digital services through one online platform. Customers can explore services, submit requirements, manage invoices and payments, track orders, and communicate with the service team. Integrated workspaces connect customers, agents, finance teams, and administrators to coordinate service delivery.

records.name: Novalede
records.tagline: Your calm personal newspaper, with the lead up front
records.description: Your agent already knows what's going on in your life, from the emails you need to read to the newsletters you never get to and the news you follow. Novalede turns that into a beautiful morning newspaper. The highlights are written as short news articles, with the lead up front, so you get the gist in minutes and can plan your day. Connect it to Claude, ChatGPT or another agent with one web address, choose what it may read, and an Evening edition wraps up your day. Free places are open now.

records.name: Always Today
records.tagline: To-do app where the AI does your legwork
records.description: A calm to-do list that keeps today in view, on iPhone, iPad, Android, Mac, Windows and the Linux terminal. Rows that are really questions (find, compare, check) carry a mark: press it and an AI does the legwork, then writes the answer into the row with its sources. It sees only that one to-do. Bring your own Claude or ChatGPT, or use ours: five free a month, then pay what you want. Works offline, with optional end-to-end encrypted sync. No ads, no tracking.

records.name: Carry
records.tagline: Save every AI conversation. Find it. Continue anywhere.
records.description: Carry saves your ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Grok chats, with projects and files, as Markdown in Obsidian or any folder. Search every word, then open any chat in another AI and keep going. NO API - NO ACCOUNTS - NO SERVERS Product Hunt special: $25 off for the next 24 hours. Use code PRODUCTHUNT at checkout.

records.name: ProofOfCite
records.tagline: Check if ChatGPT, Perplexity & Claude can read your site
records.description: Free live browserless probe checking if Cloudflare WAF or empty React/Vite SPAs secretly block OAI-SearchBot, PerplexityBot, GPTBot, and ClaudeBot. Test RFC 9309 /robots.txt, raw HTML word extraction, JSON-LD schema, and /llms.txt DNS resolution in 10 seconds with zero signup. Backed by an open-data 11-protocol benchmark and copy-paste Cloudflare Verified-Bot Skip rules.

records.name: WordLinea
records.tagline: A translation extension and a vocabulary app, in one
records.description: A translation extension and a vocabulary app in one. The extension translates pages side by side, subtitles, meeting captions and any word you select. Every word you look up is saved with its sentence, and the app quizzes you on it until you remember it.

records.name: Y-API
records.tagline: One API key for 48 LLMs. Pay per token.
records.description: One key, both wire protocols. OpenAI's /chat/completions and Anthropic's /messages reach 48 models from 12 vendors — DeepSeek, Qwen, MiniMax, Z.ai, Moonshot, Anthropic, Google, OpenAI, xAI, Tencent, Xiaomi and StepFun — on one balance. Point your SDK's base_url at ours; change nothing else. $1 buys $10 in credit, pay per token, no minimum spend, credit never expires. New accounts start with $1, no card. Prompts and responses are never written to disk; every call is itemized in the console.

records.name: Meta and Social Preview Checker
records.tagline: See how any URL looks on Google, Facebook, X and WhatsApp
records.description: Paste any URL and see exactly how it shows up in Google search and when shared on Facebook, LinkedIn, X and WhatsApp. It checks your title, meta description, canonical and Open Graph/Twitter tags, flags what is missing, too long or broken, and tells you how to fix it. Free, no sign-up.

records.name: Tajerli AI Sales Engine
records.tagline: Autonomous AI Sales Engine & COD Shield for WhatsApp
records.description: Autonomous AI sales agent & COD shield for WhatsApp. Understands Egyptian, Gulf Arabic, and English to qualify leads, resolve objections, verify Cash on Delivery orders via OTP, and recover abandoned carts 24/7 with seamless WooCommerce sync.

records.name: Etsy Fee & Profit Calculator
records.tagline: Etsy fee & profit calculator — know your real profit
records.description: Every Etsy seller knows the feeling: you make a sale, then watch the payout shrink — listing fee, 6.5% transaction fee, payment processing, a regulatory fee, and sometimes a 12–15% Offsite Ads fee you never opted into. FeesWise shows you the real number before you list. Enter your price, shipping and costs, and get an instant, itemised breakdown of every Etsy fee and your true profit per sale — including the Offsite Ads scenario. Free to use, no spreadsheet required.

records.name: Shotonia AI
records.tagline: Turn one photo into a trending AI video template.
records.description: Shotonia AI turns one photo into a short vertical AI trend video. Pick a template — Babydoll Dance, Bby Wow Guy, Santa Nice List, Santa Hat Pet and more — choose 6, 12 or 15 seconds, and download a 9:16 MP4 without a visible watermark. No prompt writing: each template is a complete page with a demo clip and examples. All videos are AI-generated. Credit-based: packs from $9.90 for 45 credits, or $14.90/month. Failed renders are refunded automatically. Sign in with Google.

records.name: Fetchproof
records.tagline: what AI agents see on your site
records.description: Fetchproof shows what an AI assistant actually gets from your homepage. Paste your web address into the free check and see whether your price, delivery, returns and what you do are written there. Then use the answers pack: type your real facts, approve every word, and add short, clear answers to your homepage.

records.name: Silsla
records.tagline: One inbox and AI agents for every customer chat
records.description: Silsla puts WhatsApp, Instagram, Messenger, Telegram, email, SMS and site chat in one shared inbox. AI agents answer from your knowledge base, take orders and book appointments, then hand off to your team. Add no-code workflows, campaigns and analytics.

records.name: PeerIntent
records.tagline: Find the people already asking for what you sell
records.description: Tell PeerIntent what you sell. It searches LinkedIn posts through your own network, your team's and a peer network of members, and reads each post to keep only real requests from buyers. You get a short list of people asking for a vendor like you, in the app and by email. Works through a Chrome extension; free to start.

records.name: Vemio
records.tagline: Practice job interviews & languages out loud with AI
records.description: Vemio is a voice-first AI coach on your phone. Talk, don't type. Interview mode: an AI recruiter adapts to the job title or pasted job ad, digs deeper when your answer is vague, then gives a score out of 100, strengths, areas to improve and the full transcript. Language mode: an AI tutor talks at your level (A1 to C2) in English, French, Spanish, Arabic, Mandarin or Swahili, gently corrects you and scores your pronunciation. Free minutes on signup, no card. iOS now, Android in open beta.

records.name: StructBy AI
records.tagline: NCC answers and site checks that show their sources
records.description: StructBy AI helps Australian structural engineers and builders with the slow, early parts of a job. Ask NCC 2025 questions in plain English and get answers from a curated knowledge base, with the sources listed and each cited clause checked. Enter an address to screen a site against the government maps we read: wind region, NCC climate zone, bushfire prone areas in five states and territories, and flood planning controls in VIC and TAS. Free to start. Results are drafts for an engineer to check.

records.name: JustCleanText
records.tagline: Paste AI text. Get clean text. Nothing leaves your browser.
records.description: JustCleanText is a free online text cleaner for AI-generated text. Paste output from ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini or Copilot and remove Markdown syntax, AI filler phrases, emoji and invisible Unicode in one pass. Keep or flatten tables, normalise smart quotes and em dashes, then copy rich text with real headings and bullets, copy plain text, or download atxt ormd file. Every pass is optional and runs entirely in your browser — no signup, no upload, no rewriting of your words.

records.name: PlanBrix
records.tagline: Quotes, invoices and payments for freelancers, in one place
records.description: PlanBrix is a web app for freelancers, creators and small creative agencies. Price work from your rate card, send quotes and invoices, track projects on a calendar and send payment reminders. Pola, the built-in AI assistant, drafts quotes, invoices and projects from a chat or your voice. Clients pay you directly; PlanBrix never holds your money. Free to start.

records.name: Birthday Calculator
records.tagline: How Old Am I in Days, Weeks & Seconds?
records.description: Free birthday calculator that shows your exact age in years, months, weeks, days, hours, minutes and seconds, the day of the week you were born, your age in dog years, your half birthday and a countdown to your next birthday.

records.name: Directory Launch Pack by LaunchLoop
records.tagline: A checked list of startup directories and how to get listed
records.description: A free list of 20 startup directories that still have a free way to submit, with the queue, any badge or link-back rule and the date we last checked each one. No signup. If you want the full list, the Directory Launch Pack has every directory we researched, with submit links, UTM links, listing copy that fits each site's limits and a CSV. The free top 20 stays free.

records.name: List AI
records.tagline: Turn photos into listings for Vinted, Wallapop, eBay
records.description: Send four photos of a jacket; get a ready-to-post listing — title, description, market price, image order — for Vinted, Wallapop, eBay and Subito, in Italian. List AI publishes to Wallapop and eBay, fills Vinted's form, prepares Subito. 5 listings free.

records.name: JayuRyoushi
records.tagline: Market intelligence for traders, every call scored in public
records.description: Market intelligence for traders. A live read of NQ, ES and gold (dealer positioning, JRVI and JRVoV volatility, the calendar, news and geopolitics) with every call graded in public, misses included. JR Markets covers everything tradable, every US stock included, each with a page of drivers, positioning, events and SEC filings, plus watchlists and price alerts. Also an FX desk, crypto and real estate engines, a strategy lab, an assistant and a network with desks and voice. Not a signal service.

records.name: FrameClip
records.tagline: Say what you want. FrameClip edits the video.
records.description: FrameClip is a video editor you talk to. Say what you want, like "cut the pauses and add captions" or "turn this podcast into Shorts", and it does the whole edit. It knows what's in all your footage, so it can find moments, cut to a voiceover, copy a reference video, animate, and add captions, music and b-roll. The fastest way for creators and marketers to make high quality videos. It all lands on a real timeline, and works from Claude, Codex or any MCP agent.

records.name: FileFerry
records.tagline: FTP, SFTP, S3, SMB and an SSH terminal in one Mac window
records.description: FileFerry is a native file transfer app for the Mac. It speaks FTP, FTPS, SFTP, WebDAV, SMB and S3, and opens a real SSH terminal on the same connection. After every transfer it checks that the file really arrived – by size, and on SFTP by checksum. Folder sync with a preview, a recovery list for interrupted transfers, strict host key and certificate checks. No account, no subscription: 7 days free, then a one-time purchase.

records.name: StudyCove
records.tagline: Turn your lecture PDFs into flashcards, quizzes & mock exams
records.description: Upload your lecture slides, notes or textbook chapters and StudyCove turns them into a full study kit: flashcards with spaced repetition, practice quizzes with per-topic scores, timed mock exams, mind maps and notes. An AI tutor answers questions from your own material, and the exam coach builds a daily plan up to your exam date so you always know what to study next.

records.name: Biz Online Kit
records.tagline: Free tools to name your business and find its domain
records.description: Describe what your business does, pick a tone (friendly, professional, playful, bold, elegant or modern) and get 10 brandable name ideas, each with a short note on why it works. Then type a seed word or phrase and get 15 domain name ideas across different extensions, modifiers and word combinations, and click any one to check whether it is available. Free, no account needed. Made by Synergy to help small business owners get online.

records.name: Sotto
records.tagline: Hold a key, speak, clean text lands at your Linux cursor
records.description: Open-source desktop dictation for Linux (Wayland & X11). Hold a shortcut in any terminal, editor, or browser, speak naturally, and Sotto transcribes with your own Groq Whisper or ElevenLabs key in ~600 ms, cleans up filler words, and pastes at your cursor.

records.name: VizToolsAI
records.tagline: AI Architectural Rendering & Video Tools
records.description: VizToolsAI helps architects and designers turn sketches and renders into presentation-ready images and videos. Generate visuals with AI, refine materials, lighting and selected areas using layers and masks, then animate scenes or connect creative steps in one workflow. Explore multiple AI models without constantly switching tools.

records.name: AoNeeNa
records.tagline: Free baby shower registry for Thailand
records.description: Baby shower registries are hard to find in Thailand, so we made a free one. Tick what your baby needs from a newborn checklist, add products from Shopee or any shop, and share one link. Guests reserve with just a name, so there are no duplicates. Thai and English, no ads.

records.name: Vizitka
records.tagline: Your business card with booking, right inside Telegram
records.description: Make a beautiful digital business card in Telegram in 2 minutes. 320+ styles, a metal 3D card, call/chat/directions buttons, prices and work photos — plus 24/7 online booking with reminders. Share it as a picture, link or QR. 3 days of Premium free.

records.name: Home Skies
records.tagline: Your own home as a weather widget
records.description: Free Lifetime for the first 100 people with code PRODUCTHUNT. The redeem link is in the first comment. Take one photo of your home and Home Skies paints it, then shows the live weather on it: rain on the roof, snow on the lawn, lights on at dusk. Open the app or keep it on your Home Screen and Lock Screen as a widget. Free to try, no account.

records.name: HRthroo
records.tagline: AI screening, phone screens and video interviews for hiring
records.description: HRthroo takes the first pass of hiring off your recruiters. It screens every CV against the job and shows the evidence behind each score, phone-screens shortlisted candidates in their own language from your own number, and runs proctored AI video interviews. Clients get an expiring shortlist link instead of a zip of CVs. Built in New Delhi for recruitment agencies and companies hiring at volume.

records.name: Occasio
records.tagline: Birthday cards they play. Dates you won't forget.
records.description: Occasio turns a photo and a few words into a birthday or anniversary card people play before they read. They pop balloons, blow out the candles, unwrap a gift, then open a letter with your photo and your words. They tap a private link. No app and no account. Save the people you love and see who is coming up, so you start the card before the day becomes a scramble. The first card is free, and you can make it without signing up.

records.name: Mira
records.tagline: A free-forever, private migraine tracker for iPhone and iPad
records.description: Mira is a free, private migraine tracker for iPhone and iPad. Log what you need, see patterns over time, and bring your history to appointments. Track severity, duration, symptoms, triggers, medications, and notes, or use a visual pain map. Export CSV or PDF. Your data stays on your device and in your private iCloud. Sync with Apple Health, and log with widgets, Siri, and Control Center shortcuts. No paywall or ads.

records.name: Homeostasis
records.tagline: Chat, calls and boards for small teams, without setup
records.description: Homeostasis is one calm room for a small team or community: chat, video calls, screen share, files and a shared Wall to plan on. Make a space in a minute and send one link. Everyone shows up as a Shelfie, a little pixel computer on a shelf. Meet people to build with in the Lobby, and keep notes the whole call sees on the Desk. It runs in your browser with nothing to download, and it's free to start with no card needed.

records.name: BotNotice
records.tagline: Clear AI disclosures for business websites
records.description: A growing number of states require businesses to tell visitors when they're interacting with AI. BotNotice adds a clear disclosure to your site in minutes, for AI chatbots and voice agents. Plans with records keep dated logs for up to 7 years. Works with WordPress, Shopify, Wix, Squarespace, Webflow, LeadConnector and GTM.

records.name: pyfect
records.tagline: Effect for Python: typed errors, services and concurrency
records.description: pyfect brings Effect's model to Python. A program's type says what it returns, how it can fail and which services it needs, so pyright rejects code that forgets to handle an error or provide a dependency. It has structured concurrency, layers, streams, schema, HTTP, SQL, RPC and AI providers, and it feels like Python: match on results, with-blocks for resources, and parallel effects on free-threaded 3.14. MIT licensed.

records.name: Atom Studio — TikTok Autopilot
records.tagline: TikTok Automation & Autopilot
records.description: Atom Studio is autopilot for TikTok growth. It finds proven Instagram Reels in your niche, AI-remasters them so they pass duplicate checks, and posts them across unlimited accounts on a schedule — no ad spend, no editing, no manual uploads. Built for creators, agencies and founders who want consistent short-form reach without hiring a social team. Connect your accounts, pick a niche, and let the pipeline source, transform and publish every day.

records.name: Emotional Balance Essential Oil Trio
records.tagline: Bergamot, ylang ylang and lavender essential oil trio
records.description: Rootsar Emotional Balance is a three-oil set of bergamot, ylang ylang and lavender, with citrus, sweet floral and floral scents. It's vegan, natural and cruelty-free. Try the oils in a diffuser, a jojoba roll-on blend or a coconut oil massage blend.

records.name: CleanPDF Compress PDF
records.tagline: Shrink PDFs to an exact size, right in your browser
records.description: Compress PDFs to an exact target size (100 KB, 200 KB, 1 MB or custom) or pick Light, Balanced or Strong. Images shrink while text, fonts, links and form fields stay sharp and searchable. Files never leave your device, with no watermark, sign-up or daily limits.

records.name: Satsails
records.tagline: Bitcoin and stablecoins, beyond borders
records.description: Satsails is a multi-chain, non-custodial wallet for Bitcoin and stablecoins, built with Tether WDK. Send, receive, buy, sell and swap digital assets with integrations including SideShift.ai and SideSwap. Our roadmap expands into payments, financial services, lending, earning, trading, prediction markets and open P2P infrastructure.

records.name: RookerAI
records.tagline: AI agent that runs your X, LinkedIn & Reddit toward a goal
records.description: RookerAI is an AI agent that runs your X, LinkedIn or Reddit account toward a goal you set. It plans a strategy, engages as you from a Chrome side panel, measures what works and changes course, and shows its reasoning. Start free: 200 coins, no card.

records.name: Inkuity.fit
records.tagline: Free Gym Management Software with QR Check-Ins
records.description: Free gym management software with QR code check-ins, membership and payment tracking, automatic WhatsApp renewal reminders, live analytics, staff and expense tracking, and a branded member app with workout tracking, AI calorie tracking, streaks and personal records.

records.name: Skillpedia
records.tagline: Teach your AI to do any task the right way, for free
records.description: Skills teach your AI to do a task the right way. Skillpedia finds them: search by task, see the best ones first, or grab a pack with several skills in one link. Or plug in the free MCP and let your AI pick the skill by itself, or use the free API to put skills in your own app.

records.name: B4Bots
records.tagline: Bot Population Index: Robots, AI Agents & Bots, Counted
records.description: B4Bots is a Bot Population Index: physical robots, robotaxis, cleanup bots, AI agents and automation bots, counted in one place — plus a launch feed for what's new, with upvotes.

records.name: PM AI Starter Kit
records.tagline: Thirty years of PM practice, in your AI.
records.description: Thirty years of PM practice, packaged for the AI you already use. Describe what happened: "we have a risk." The procedures ask until they have real answers, never invent facts, and land the record: a row in a 17-tab workbook, a document to forward, and a dashboard ranking what needs attention. Eleven procedures, kickoff to closeout. ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or paste into any AI. $29 once. Your data stays on your machine. Includes The Explainer, a 15-page plain-English ebook.

records.name: MOONSiege
records.tagline: Free browser space strategy. Uni 1 never wipes.
records.description: MOONSiege is Moon, a free browser space-strategy game in the OGame tradition. Mine resources, research technology, build fleets, and fight for galaxy coordinates — no download. Uni 1 never wipes; sign up with email. Open source as HiveNova (AGPL-3.0).

records.name: PDFkoko
records.tagline: Free PDF and image tools to convert, compress & edit online
records.description: PDFKoko is a free online toolkit for PDF and image tasks. Convert, compress, merge and split PDFs, resize and convert images with ease. No registration, subscriptions or payments. Simple tools, all in one place. Make PDFs Easy!

records.name: Firefly Support
records.tagline: Answers app reviews and Gmail, merges duplicate bug reports
records.description: Firefly answers your Google Play, App Store and Gmail messages in each customer's language, merges duplicate reports into one bug, and replies to everyone who reported it when you ship the fix. Free plan, no card.

records.name: Animus AI Blocker
records.tagline: Less AI slop in your feeds on Android, Chrome and Firefox
records.description: Choose which feeds to filter and keep scrolling. Animus covers AI-labelled posts on supported sites and apps, including X, Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts on Android. Tap to reveal a post whenever you want. Also available as a Chrome and Firefox extension.

records.name: Chronyte
records.tagline: AI-Powered Social Media Management & Scheduling
records.description: Chronyte is an AI-powered social media management and scheduling application. Easily generate, curate, schedule, and analyze posts across multiple social networks.

records.name: Ray Scan
records.tagline: The iPhone document scanner that cleans every page
records.description: Ray Scan turns your iPhone into a precision document scanner. It finds the page, straightens it and removes shadows, then exports a sharp PDF. Fill in forms and sign them, redact, merge and compress PDFs, and send scans to iCloud Drive, Google Drive, Dropbox or OneDrive, all free. With AI: translate a page on the image itself, ask a document a question, turn receipts into expense reports, and have new scans named and filed for you.

records.name: FormRill
records.tagline: Form backend for static sites that never loses a lead
records.description: Static and AI-built sites have no server, so form leads go to an email that can bounce or land in spam. FormRill stores every submission first, holds spam (never billed), then sends leads to email, webhooks or Google Sheets. One line of HTML. 500/mo free.

records.name: Inkflit
records.tagline: A floating Markdown notebook with useful blocks for Mac
records.description: Inkflit is a local-first floating notebook for macOS. Capture Markdown notes, checklists, calculations, and code in one place. Summon it with a shortcut, use optional Vim editing, and keep your notes as local files.

records.name: ForgeTek Solutions
records.tagline: Vet engineers consistently — playbook + hiring system
records.description: ForgeTek brings structure to technical hiring with the 5-Layer Vetting System — resume audit, skills assessment, live interview, scenario problem-solving, and culture fit — in a 38-page playbook plus editable templates. Bundle $250, save $48.

records.name: PlanFalcon
records.tagline: Construction sales intelligence and lead qualification.
records.description: PlanFalcon turns UK planning applications, tenders and contract awards into a ranked shortlist of construction leads. It scores every project for fit with your trade, location and timing, shows why it qualifies, and drafts the first outreach email. Built for contractors, subcontractors, suppliers and BD teams who'd rather win work than trawl council portals.

records.name: Lexly
records.tagline: Snap anything, learn its name in another language
records.description: Point your iPhone at anything. Lexly peels it out of the photo like a sticker and tells you its name in the language you're learning, with pronunciation and a short explanation in your own language. Every word keeps its photo, and review is two buttons backed by spaced repetition. No account: your words stay on your phone. 5 new words a day free, Pro removes the limit.

records.name: ERPHub Ask
records.tagline: ChatGPT & Claude for your Odoo
records.description: ERPHub Ask lets your team ask Odoo questions in plain English or Arabic, inside ChatGPT, Claude or a built-in chat. Revenue, receivables, stock, margins, trial balance, aging: the AI picks the right Odoo models, runs read-only queries on your live data and explains the result. Nothing to install on Odoo. Writes and secret models are blocked, credentials encrypted, every call logged. Unlimited databases and users. 7-day free trial, then $20/month.

records.name: RobloxHorror
records.tagline: Roblox horror games, ranked by live player data.
records.description: RobloxHorror is a hand-checked index of Roblox horror games, ranked by live player counts, favourites and likes instead of stale top-ten lists. Each entry records the game's current player count, player limit, mic support, content warnings and a short guide, so you know what you're joining before you load in.

records.name: Vaneform
records.tagline: Free website traffic checker with dated source signals
records.description: Look up any public domain's estimated monthly visits, traffic sources, top countries, and search visibility — free, no sign-up required. Whole-site traffic and organic search stay separate, with source, observation date, and confidence beside every metric. Includes growth, AI-tool, disclosed-revenue, and 100+ country/category boards, bulk compare, 7 client-side SEO/AI-crawler utilities, REST API, and an open-source MCP server.

records.name: cwsweep
records.tagline: Clean up CloudWatch Logs across your whole AWS Organization
records.description: Forgotten "Never expire" log groups quietly add to your AWS bill. cwsweep scans every member account and region in one command, lets you pick what to delete or put a retention on, dry-runs by default, re-checks each account with STS, and writes an audit log.

records.name: Pertin
records.tagline: Remote support for Windows, no account required
records.description: Pertin helps technicians connect to a Windows PC with the user’s permission. The person at the PC shares an ID and password, then approves the connection. Technicians can also connect from an Android device. The free option works without an account, with Pro Solo and Equipe plans available.

records.name: Photo to Line Drawing
records.tagline: Turn photos into editable SVG line art & printable PDFs
records.description: Convert photos into clean line art — no pencil shading. One credit unlocks editable SVG paths, 300 DPI PNG, and print-ready A4/US Letter PDFs (plus 10-page coloring books with covers). 3 free previews; non-expiring packs start at $6.90 for 150 images.

records.name: DataVow
records.tagline: Privacy and Consent Orchestration Across Jurisdictions
records.description: DataVow turns privacy choices into accountable action. Manage notices, consent, preferences, individual rights requests, retention and processor oversight across jurisdictions. When consent is withdrawn, coordinate follow-through across connected systems, route exceptions to owners and preserve traceable evidence. Start with a free privacy readiness assessment or scope a trial for your own workflow. DataVow works independently or alongside AegisDatastra for AI and business process governance.

records.name: GemHunter
records.tagline: 100-point forensic audits for crypto before you invest
records.description: Crypto has plenty of hype. GemHunter audits the evidence. Every project is scored on the same 100-point forensic rubric across six weighted categories, and claims that can't be verified on-chain or in public records don't count. Each audit is published as a case file with a score, a clear verdict and the evidence behind it. Zero paid placements.

records.name: Molimoya
records.tagline: Guided reflection through voice, music, and storytelling
records.description: Molimoya combines guided audio rituals, original music, and cinematic storytelling to create space for reflection and self-discovery. Explore immersive experiences, capture your thoughts, and reconnect with yourself at your own pace. Available on iOS and Android.

records.name: Owlsort
records.tagline: Tidy Desktop & Downloads — preview first, undo anytime
records.description: Owlsort sorts the screenshots, PDFs, installers and archives piling up in your Downloads and Desktop, on Mac and Windows. See every move before it happens, undo any run, and keep it all on your own computer. A little robot can even tidy your desktop for you.

records.name: Texter
records.tagline: An extremely fast LaTeX editor for real-time collaboration
records.description: A LaTeX editor built for many small changes: recompiles in a fraction of a second, free, in your browser, no account.

records.name: Smart BIAI
records.tagline: AI social operations from video creation to publishing
records.description: Smart BIAI is an all-in-one AI video creation and social media operations platform for global teams. With the Smart BIAI Agent, teams can create videos, manage social accounts and content, schedule posts, and analyze performance in one workspace. It uses company-authorized data to help teams understand results and identify their next growth opportunities.

records.name: Gridverse
records.tagline: Gamified Excel & Sheets App + Pocket Formula Co-Pilot
records.description: Master Excel & Google Sheets in 5-minute daily sessions—no 40-hour video marathons. Snap LEGO-style formula blocks with live evaluation, defeat Error Boss Battles (#REF!, #DIV/0!, #VALUE!, #N/A) alongside Celdi, and climb a 36-level skill tree. Need an answer at work? Keep the 107-formula + 32-shortcut pocket co-pilot open beside your keyboard. Native 6-language syntax (XLOOKUP/BUSCARX/RECHERCHEX/XVERWEIS/PROCX, vs) for iOS, Android & Web.

records.name: PermaNatura
records.tagline: Garden planning, permaculture & sustainable land care
records.description: PermaNatura unites garden planning, permaculture and care for living land. Design beds, zones and fields; explore companion planting, crop rotation, soil and weather context. Get AI guidance and seasonal calendars, alongside traditional gardening knowledge. Record tasks, observations and harvests over time, with team tools and exportable field records for farms and shared spaces. From balcony planters to community landscapes, grow with nature—not against it. Free core plan; open beta, no ads.

records.name: Webdesly Luxury Business OS
records.tagline: Quiet software for maisons, agencies and operators
records.description: Quiet modular suite for maisons, agencies and private operators: twenty live Phase 0 modules — from Atelier and Estate to Vault, Salon, Club and Air — in one house. Not another generic CRM, not a monolith. Free live demos, no signup.

records.name: Between The Wickets - Cricket Analytics
records.tagline: Cricket Analytics and Scoring - Your Virtual Coach
records.description: Net Session Analytics Ball Speed Match Scoring Fielding Tracking Team and Tournament Manager Virtual Coaching Dashboards

records.name: fmsg.ai
records.tagline: Messaging for the AI era
records.description: Often sharingmd files with your co-workers? fmsg.ai gives people and their AI agents an @address to message each other directly. fmsg is a new open messaging protocol faster and safer than email, without the lock-in of chat apps. fmsg.ai is an fmsg hosting provider with free Individual accounts, and, paid Teams accounts for hosting yourdomain.com addresses. With fmsg every message forms part of a thread, cryptographically making them tamper-proof and immutable. Claim your free fmsg address.

records.name: Clam AI
records.tagline: Your inbox, safely shared with AI agents
records.description: Your inbox is a master key: password resets, bank alerts and health reports all run through it. Clam lets AI agents work in your email without holding that key. You write the rules in plain English, like "Read travel email. Draft replies. Never send." Each agent sees and does only what its rules allow, and you see everything it tries. We start with Gmail. We are building the permission layer for MCP: one that understands what the data means and the context of every request.

records.name: Almma's PII Guard
records.tagline: Catch personal data before it reaches your AI chat
records.description: A free, open-source browser extension that flags names, emails, numbers, dates and addresses in the message box of claude.ai and chat.almma.ai, and replaces them with placeholders like [NAME_1] before you send. Pasted text is held for review. Typed text is underlined in red and Send is blocked until you decide. Everything runs locally: the code contains no network calls, and the README shows how to check. MIT licensed.

records.name: HeroUI Pro 1.0
records.tagline: Premium UI components, templates, and AI tooling for React
records.description: HeroUI Pro is the premium tier of HeroUI (formerly NextUI). 118+ production-ready Pro components with 900+ examples: 65+ for React, built on Tailwind CSS v4 and React Aria (data grid, charts, kanban, agenda, rich text editor, maps, and a full AI chat kit), and 53+ for React Native on iOS and Android. Plus full-page templates, and MCP servers and Agent Skills so Cursor and Claude build with your design system. One perpetual license, unlimited projects.

records.name: Agenda Hero Magic Labs
records.tagline: Any schedule. Any layout. Any style.
records.description: We’re replacing the static PDF calendar with a new kind of artifact built for date and time. From the team offsite to the soccer season, make a beautifully designed plan. It’s powered by live data, so when the plan changes, the design and subscribed calendars stay up to date. Try it today in Agenda Hero Magic Labs.

records.name: Pinned
records.tagline: Ask the city where to go tonight with your friends
records.description: Ask Pinned where to go tonight, the way you'd text a friend who knows the city. Pinned AI reads every spot nearby and brings back the three that fit your whole crew, with a reason for each. Then drop a pin with the plan, and your friends say "I'm down" in one tap. Try a real Ask at pinned.social, no download needed. Free on iPhone and Android, made in New York for people who'd rather be out than online.

records.name: Drift
records.tagline: Wallpaper that reflects the world around you
records.description: Drift is a living wallpaper for Mac. It paints slow, moving gradients on your desktop that shift with the time of day and your local weather: warm light at sunset, rain, snow and storms when they arrive. Start with one of our nine beautiful palettes or generate your own. Turn on Real Sky to match the light and weather conditions outside your window. It runs as your real wallpaper on every display, and as your screen saver too. Free for 14 days. Launch price $12/year until December 18, then $15.

records.name: Valley
records.tagline: Outbound system to find people most likely to buy from you
records.description: Valley finds the people most likely to buy from you, from live buying signals, plain-English search or your own lists. It checks each one against your ICP, researches them, and writes a personal message across LinkedIn and email. You approve every message, replies land in one inbox, and it runs from Claude or ChatGPT via MCP. Teams see 15-45% reply rates vs about 2% for cold outreach. Bolt.new booked 25 enterprise demos in 45 days. Book a demo to see it on your own leads.

records.name: doola MCP
records.tagline: Start and run your US company from your AI assistant
records.description: The doola MCP lets founders start and run a US company from ChatGPT, Claude, and any tool that supports MCP. Form an LLC or C-Corp in any of the 50 states in one chat, from account setup to submission. Already a doola customer? Connect your account and ask your AI Co-Founder for your EIN letter, formation documents and deadlines. doola Bookkeeping customers can also pull financial reports, and connected Shopify or ad accounts add sales and ad spend trends. Add mcp.doola.com as a connector.
